    21	    private static let filenameFormatter: DateFormatter = {
    22	        let formatter = DateFormatter()

    28	    static func saveScreenshotImage(
    29	        _ image: NSImage,
    30	        workspaceURL: URL,
    31	        noteURL: URL,
    32	        now: Date = Date()
    33	    ) throws -> StoredMediaAsset {
    34	        let fileManager = FileManager.default
    35	        let mediaDirectory = workspaceURL.appendingPathComponent("media", isDirectory: true)
    36	        try fileManager.createDirectory(at: mediaDirectory, withIntermediateDirectories: true)
    37	
    38	        guard let imageData = image.pngDataRepresentation else {
    39	            throw MediaManagerError.imageEncodingFailed
    40	        }
    41	
    42	        let timestamp = filenameFormatter.string(from: now)
    43	        let baseName = "screenshot-\(timestamp)"
    44	        var suffixNumber = 1
    45	        var fileName = "\(baseName).png"
    46	        var fileURL = mediaDirectory.appendingPathComponent(fileName)
    47	
    48	        while fileManager.fileExists(atPath: fileURL.path) {
    49	            suffixNumber += 1
    50	            fileName = "\(baseName)-\(suffixNumber).png"
    51	            fileURL = mediaDirectory.appendingPathComponent(fileName)
    52	        }
    53	
    54	        try imageData.write(to: fileURL, options: [.atomic])
    55	
    56	        let noteDirectory = noteURL.deletingLastPathComponent()
    57	        let relativePath = relativePath(from: noteDirectory, to: fileURL)
    58	        return StoredMediaAsset(fileURL: fileURL, relativePath: relativePath)
    59	    }

    61	    static func screenshotURLs(in workspaceURL: URL) -> [URL] {
    62	        let mediaDirectory = workspaceURL.appendingPathComponent("media", isDirectory: true)
    63	        let properties: [URLResourceKey] = [.isDirectoryKey, .contentModificationDateKey]
    64	
    65	        guard let contents = try? FileManager.default.contentsOfDirectory(
    66	            at: mediaDirectory,
    67	            includingPropertiesForKeys: properties
    68	        ) else { return [] }
    69	
    70	        return contents
    71	            .filter { mediaURL in
    72	                guard isSupportedImageFile(mediaURL) else { return false }
    73	                return mediaURL.deletingPathExtension()
    74	                    .lastPathComponent
    75	                    .lowercased()
    76	                    .contains("screenshot")
    77	            }
    78	            .sorted { firstURL, secondURL in
    79	                let firstValues = try? firstURL.resourceValues(forKeys: [.contentModificationDateKey])
    80	                let secondValues = try? secondURL.resourceValues(forKeys: [.contentModificationDateKey])
    81	                let firstDate = firstValues?.contentModificationDate ?? .distantPast
    82	                let secondDate = secondValues?.contentModificationDate ?? .distantPast
    83	                return firstDate > secondDate
    84	            }
    85	    }
    86	
    87	    static func relativePath(from baseDirectoryURL: URL, to destinationURL: URL) -> String {
    88	        let baseParts = baseDirectoryURL.standardizedFileURL.pathComponents
    89	        let destinationParts = destinationURL.standardizedFileURL.pathComponents
    90	        let sharedCount = sharedPathPrefixCount(first: baseParts, second: destinationParts)
    91	
    92	        let parentSegments = Array(repeating: "..", count: baseParts.count - sharedCount)
    93	        let destinationSegments = Array(destinationParts.dropFirst(sharedCount))
    94	        let fullSegments = parentSegments + destinationSegments
    95	        return fullSegments.isEmpty ? "." : fullSegments.joined(separator: "/")
    96	    }
    97	
    98	    static func resolvedImageURL(from path: String, baseDirectoryURL: URL?) -> URL? {
    99	        let trimmedPath = path.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines)
   100	        guard !trimmedPath.isEmpty else { return nil }
   101	
   102	        if let absoluteURL = URL(string: trimmedPath), absoluteURL.scheme != nil {
   103	            return absoluteURL
   104	        }
   105	
   106	        guard let baseDirectoryURL else { return nil }
   107	        return URL(fileURLWithPath: trimmedPath, relativeTo: baseDirectoryURL).standardizedFileURL
   108	    }
   109	
   110	    static func isSupportedImageFile(_ mediaURL: URL) -> Bool {
   111	        let ext = mediaURL.pathExtension.lowercased()
   112	        guard supportedExtensions.contains(ext) else { return false }
   113	        let isDirectory = (try? mediaURL.resourceValues(forKeys: [.isDirectoryKey]).isDirectory) ?? false
   114	        return !isDirectory
   115	    }
   116	
   117	    private static func sharedPathPrefixCount(first: [String], second: [String]) -> Int {
   118	        let countLimit = min(first.count, second.count)
   119	        var sharedCount = 0
   120	        while sharedCount < countLimit && first[sharedCount] == second[sharedCount] {
   121	            sharedCount += 1
   122	        }
   123	        return sharedCount
   124	    }
   125	}

   167	final class WorkspaceImageLoader: @unchecked Sendable {
   168	    static let shared = WorkspaceImageLoader()
   169	
   170	    private let decodeQueue = DispatchQueue(
   171	        label: "synth.workspace-image-loader.decode",
   172	        qos: .userInitiated,
   173	        attributes: .concurrent
   174	    )
   175	    private let stateQueue = DispatchQueue(label: "synth.workspace-image-loader.state")
   176	    private let imageCache = NSCache<NSString, NSImage>()
   177	    private var inFlight: [String: [(NSImage?) -> Void]] = [:]
   178	
   179	    private init() {}
   180	
   181	    func cachedImage(at imageURL: URL, maxSize: NSSize) -> NSImage? {
   182	        let cacheKey = key(for: imageURL, maxSize: maxSize)
   183	        return stateQueue.sync {
   184	            imageCache.object(forKey: cacheKey as NSString)
   185	        }
   186	    }
   187	
   188	    func loadImage(at imageURL: URL, maxSize: NSSize, completion: @escaping (NSImage?) -> Void) {
   189	        let cacheKey = key(for: imageURL, maxSize: maxSize)
   190	
   191	        if let cached = cachedImage(at: imageURL, maxSize: maxSize) {
   192	            completion(cached)
   193	            return
   194	        }
   195	
   196	        var shouldStartDecode = false
   197	        stateQueue.sync {
   198	            if var callbacks = inFlight[cacheKey] {
   199	                callbacks.append(completion)
   200	                inFlight[cacheKey] = callbacks
   201	            } else {
   202	                inFlight[cacheKey] = [completion]
   203	                shouldStartDecode = true
   204	            }
   205	        }
   206	
   207	        guard shouldStartDecode else { return }
   208	
   209	        decodeQueue.async {
   210	            let decoded = Self.decodeImage(at: imageURL, maxSize: maxSize)
   211	
   212	            let callbacks: [(NSImage?) -> Void] = self.stateQueue.sync {
   213	                if let decoded {
   214	                    self.imageCache.setObject(decoded, forKey: cacheKey as NSString)
   215	                }
   216	                return self.inFlight.removeValue(forKey: cacheKey) ?? []
   217	            }
   218	
   219	            DispatchQueue.main.async {
   220	                callbacks.forEach { callback in
   221	                    callback(decoded)
   222	                }
   223	            }
   224	        }
   225	    }
   226	
   227	    private func key(for imageURL: URL, maxSize: NSSize) -> String {
   228	        let width = Int(maxSize.width.rounded())
   229	        let height = Int(maxSize.height.rounded())
   230	        return "\(imageURL.path)#\(width)x\(height)"
   231	    }
   232	
   233	    private static func decodeImage(at imageURL: URL, maxSize: NSSize) -> NSImage? {
   234	        guard let source = CGImageSourceCreateWithURL(imageURL as CFURL, nil) else { return nil }
   235	
   236	        let maxPixelSize = max(Int(maxSize.width), Int(maxSize.height))
   237	        let options: [CFString: Any] = [
   238	            kCGImageSourceCreateThumbnailFromImageAlways: true,
   239	            kCGImageSourceCreateThumbnailWithTransform: true,
   240	            kCGImageSourceThumbnailMaxPixelSize: max(maxPixelSize, 1),
   241	            kCGImageSourceShouldCacheImmediately: true
   242	        ]
   243	
   244	        guard let thumbnail = CGImageSourceCreateThumbnailAtIndex(
   245	            source,
   246	            0,
   247	            options as CFDictionary
   248	        ) else { return nil }
   249	
   250	        let imageSize = NSSize(width: thumbnail.width, height: thumbnail.height)
   251	        return NSImage(cgImage: thumbnail, size: imageSize)
   252	    }
   253	}

   541	    private static func cleanOrphanedMedia(
   542	        mediaFiles: [URL], workspace: URL
   543	    ) -> Set<URL> {
   544	        var removed: Set<URL> = []
   545	        for mediaURL in mediaFiles {
   546	            let filename = mediaURL.lastPathComponent
   547	            var isReferenced = false
   548	            let enumerator = FileManager.default.enumerator(
   549	                at: workspace,
   550	                includingPropertiesForKeys: [.isDirectoryKey],
   551	                options: [.skipsHiddenFiles]
   552	            )
   553	            while let fileURL = enumerator?.nextObject() as? URL {
   554	                guard fileURL.pathExtension == "md",
   555	                      let content = try? String(
   556	                          contentsOf: fileURL, encoding: .utf8
   557	                      ),
   558	                      content.contains(filename)
   559	                else { continue }
   560	                isReferenced = true
   561	                break
   562	            }
   563	            if !isReferenced {
   564	                try? FileManager.default.trashItem(
   565	                    at: mediaURL, resultingItemURL: nil
   566	                )
   567	                removed.insert(mediaURL)
   568	            }
   569	        }
   570	        return removed
   571	    }

   840	    func saveAll() {
   841	        // Collect documents to save on main thread
   842	        var docsToSave: [(url: URL, content: String, isDocx: Bool, index: Int)] = []
   843	        var renameOps: [(index: Int, oldURL: URL, newURL: URL)] = []
   844	
   845	        for index in openFiles.indices where openFiles[index].isDirty {
   846	            let doc = openFiles[index]
   847	            let isDocx = doc.url.pathExtension.lowercased() == "docx"
   848	
   849	            // For docx, save synchronously (needs attributed string)
   850	            if isDocx {
   851	                try? doc.save(doc.content)
   852	            } else {
   853	                docsToSave.append((doc.url, doc.content.string, isDocx, index))
   854	            }
   855	
   856	            // Check for rename
   857	            if doc.url.lastPathComponent.hasPrefix("Untitled"),
   858	               let newURL = renamedURL(for: doc) {
   859	                renameOps.append((index, doc.url, newURL))
   860	            }
   861	
   862	            openFiles[index].isDirty = false
   863	
   864	            // Update indexes on main thread
   865	            let savedURL = openFiles[index].url
   866	            let savedContent = openFiles[index].content.string
   867	            noteIndex.updateFile(savedURL, content: savedContent)
   868	            backlinkIndex.updateFile(savedURL, content: savedContent)
   869	            tagIndex.updateFile(savedURL, content: savedContent)
   870	            peopleIndex.updateFile(savedURL, content: savedContent)
   871	        }
   872	
   873	        // Background save for plain text files
   874	        if !docsToSave.isEmpty {
   875	            saveQueue.cancelAllOperations()
   876	            let operation = BlockOperation { [docsToSave] in
   877	                for doc in docsToSave {
   878	                    try? doc.content.write(to: doc.url, atomically: true, encoding: .utf8)
   879	                }
   880	            }
   881	            saveQueue.addOperation(operation)
   882	        }
   883	
   884	        // Handle renames on main thread
   885	        for rename in renameOps {
   886	            try? FileManager.default.moveItem(at: rename.oldURL, to: rename.newURL)
   887	            let content = openFiles[rename.index].content
   888	            openFiles[rename.index] = Document(url: rename.newURL, content: content)
   889	        }
   890	        if !renameOps.isEmpty { loadFileTree() }
   891	
   892	        dailyNoteManager.saveAll()
   893	    }

   895	    private func renamedURL(for doc: Document) -> URL? {
   896	        let firstLine = doc.content.string.components(separatedBy: "\n").first ?? ""
   897	        let cleaned = firstLine
   898	            .trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespaces)
   899	            .replacingOccurrences(of: "#", with: "")
   900	            .trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespaces)
   901	            .prefix(50)
   902	        guard !cleaned.isEmpty else { return nil }
   903	        let safeName = String(cleaned).replacingOccurrences(of: "/", with: "-")
   904	        let ext = doc.url.pathExtension
   905	        let newURL = doc.url.deletingLastPathComponent()
   906	            .appendingPathComponent("\(safeName).\(ext)")
   907	        guard !FileManager.default.fileExists(atPath: newURL.path) else { return nil }
   908	        return newURL
   909	    }

   935	    func addFileToInMemoryTree(_ fileURL: URL) {
   936	        guard let workspace else { return }
   937	        let relativePath = fileURL.path.replacingOccurrences(
   938	            of: workspace.path + "/", with: ""
   939	        )
   940	        let components = relativePath.split(separator: "/").map(String.init)
   941	        guard !components.isEmpty else { return }
   942	        fileTree = Self.insertingNode(fileURL, path: components, into: fileTree)

   944	
   945	    private static func insertingNode(
   946	        _ target: URL,
   947	        path: [String],
   948	        into nodes: [FileTreeNode]
   949	    ) -> [FileTreeNode] {
   950	        guard let first = path.first else { return nodes }
   951	        let rest = Array(path.dropFirst())
   952	
   953	        for (index, node) in nodes.enumerated() where node.url.lastPathComponent == first {
   954	            if rest.isEmpty {
   955	                return nodes // Already exists
   956	            }
   957	            if node.isDirectory, let children = node.children {
   958	                var updated = nodes
   959	                updated[index] = FileTreeNode(
   960	                    url: node.url,
   961	                    isDirectory: true,
   962	                    children: insertingNode(target, path: rest, into: children)
   963	                )
   964	                return updated
   965	            }
   966	            return nodes
   967	        }
   968	
   969	        // Not found — add new node
   970	        if rest.isEmpty {
   971	            let newNode = FileTreeNode(url: target, isDirectory: false, children: nil)
   972	            return (nodes + [newNode]).sorted { $0.url.lastPathComponent < $1.url.lastPathComponent }
   973	        }
   974	        return nodes
   975	    }
   976	
   977	    private static func removingNode(_ target: URL, from nodes: [FileTreeNode]) -> [FileTreeNode] {
   978	        nodes.compactMap { node in
   979	            if equivalentFileURL(node.url, target) {
   980	                return nil
   981	            }
   982	
   983	            if node.isDirectory, let children = node.children {
   984	                let prunedChildren = removingNode(target, from: children)
   985	                return FileTreeNode(url: node.url, isDirectory: true, children: prunedChildren)
   986	            }
   987	
   988	            return node
   989	        }
   990	    }

  1166	    @discardableResult
  1167	    func delete(_ url: URL) -> Bool {
  1168	        let candidates = Self.deletionCandidates(for: url)
  1169	
  1170	        // Close if open (canonical path match prevents stale tabs)
  1171	        if let idx = openFiles.firstIndex(
  1172	            where: { openFile in
  1173	                candidates.contains { Self.equivalentFileURL(openFile.url, $0) }
  1174	            }
  1175	        ) {
  1176	            closeTab(at: idx)
  1177	        }
  1178	
  1179	        switch deleteFromDisk(url, scope: .workspace) {
  1180	        case .deleted(let deletedURL):
  1181	            resetFileTreeScanState()
  1182	            removeFileFromInMemoryTree(deletedURL)
  1183	            rebuildIndexesFromCurrentTree()
  1184	            scheduleFileTreeReload(delaySeconds: 0.6)
  1185	            return true
  1186	        case .notFound:
  1187	            resetFileTreeScanState()
  1188	            removeFileFromInMemoryTree(url)
  1189	            rebuildIndexesFromCurrentTree()

   374	            info: UnsafeMutableRawPointer(Unmanaged.passRetained(context).toOpaque()),
   375	            retain: watcherContextRetain,
   376	            release: watcherContextRelease,
   377	            copyDescription: nil
   378	        )
   379	
   380	        let watchPaths = [workspace.path] as CFArray
   381	        let streamFlags = FSEventStreamCreateFlags(
   382	            kFSEventStreamCreateFlagFileEvents
   383	                | kFSEventStreamCreateFlagNoDefer
   384	                | kFSEventStreamCreateFlagUseCFTypes
   385	        )
   386	
   387	        guard let stream = FSEventStreamCreate(
   388	            kCFAllocatorDefault,
   389	            Self.workspaceEventCallback,
   390	            &streamContext,
   391	            watchPaths,
   392	            FSEventStreamEventId(kFSEventStreamEventIdSinceNow),
   393	            0.2,
   394	            streamFlags
   395	        ) else {
   396	            return
   397	        }
   398	
   399	        FSEventStreamSetDispatchQueue(stream, DispatchQueue.main)
   400	        if FSEventStreamStart(stream) {
   401	            fileEventStream = stream
   402	        } else {
   403	            FSEventStreamInvalidate(stream)
   404	            FSEventStreamRelease(stream)
   405	            watcherContext = nil
   406	        }
   407	    }

   415	        watcherContext = nil

   541	    private static func cleanOrphanedMedia(
   542	        mediaFiles: [URL], workspace: URL
   543	    ) -> Set<URL> {
   544	        var removed: Set<URL> = []
   545	        for mediaURL in mediaFiles {
   546	            let filename = mediaURL.lastPathComponent
   547	            var isReferenced = false
   548	            let enumerator = FileManager.default.enumerator(
   549	                at: workspace,
   550	                includingPropertiesForKeys: [.isDirectoryKey],
   551	                options: [.skipsHiddenFiles]
   552	            )
   553	            while let fileURL = enumerator?.nextObject() as? URL {
   554	                guard fileURL.pathExtension == "md",
   555	                      let content = try? String(
   556	                          contentsOf: fileURL, encoding: .utf8
   557	                      ),
   558	                      content.contains(filename)
   559	                else { continue }
   560	                isReferenced = true
   561	                break
   562	            }
   563	            if !isReferenced {
   564	                try? FileManager.default.trashItem(
   565	                    at: mediaURL, resultingItemURL: nil
   566	                )
   567	                removed.insert(mediaURL)
   568	            }
   569	        }
   570	        return removed
   571	    }

   840	    func saveAll() {
   841	        // Collect documents to save on main thread
   842	        var docsToSave: [(url: URL, content: String, isDocx: Bool, index: Int)] = []
   843	        var renameOps: [(index: Int, oldURL: URL, newURL: URL)] = []
   844	
   845	        for index in openFiles.indices where openFiles[index].isDirty {
   846	            let doc = openFiles[index]
   847	            let isDocx = doc.url.pathExtension.lowercased() == "docx"
   848	
   849	            // For docx, save synchronously (needs attributed string)
   850	            if isDocx {
   851	                try? doc.save(doc.content)
   852	            } else {
   853	                docsToSave.append((doc.url, doc.content.string, isDocx, index))
   854	            }
   855	
   856	            // Check for rename
   857	            if doc.url.lastPathComponent.hasPrefix("Untitled"),
   858	               let newURL = renamedURL(for: doc) {
   859	                renameOps.append((index, doc.url, newURL))
   860	            }
   861	
   862	            openFiles[index].isDirty = false
   863	
   864	            // Update indexes on main thread
   865	            let savedURL = openFiles[index].url
   866	            let savedContent = openFiles[index].content.string
   867	            noteIndex.updateFile(savedURL, content: savedContent)
   868	            backlinkIndex.updateFile(savedURL, content: savedContent)
   869	            tagIndex.updateFile(savedURL, content: savedContent)
   870	            peopleIndex.updateFile(savedURL, content: savedContent)
   871	        }
   872	
   873	        // Background save for plain text files
   874	        if !docsToSave.isEmpty {
   875	            saveQueue.cancelAllOperations()
   876	            let operation = BlockOperation { [docsToSave] in
   877	                for doc in docsToSave {
   878	                    try? doc.content.write(to: doc.url, atomically: true, encoding: .utf8)
   879	                }
   880	            }
   881	            saveQueue.addOperation(operation)
   882	        }
   883	
   884	        // Handle renames on main thread
   885	        for rename in renameOps {
   886	            try? FileManager.default.moveItem(at: rename.oldURL, to: rename.newURL)
   887	            let content = openFiles[rename.index].content
   888	            openFiles[rename.index] = Document(url: rename.newURL, content: content)
   889	        }
   890	        if !renameOps.isEmpty { loadFileTree() }
   891	
   892	        dailyNoteManager.saveAll()
   893	    }

   895	    private func renamedURL(for doc: Document) -> URL? {
   896	        let firstLine = doc.content.string.components(separatedBy: "\n").first ?? ""
   897	        let cleaned = firstLine
   898	            .trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespaces)
   899	            .replacingOccurrences(of: "#", with: "")
   900	            .trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespaces)
   901	            .prefix(50)
   902	        guard !cleaned.isEmpty else { return nil }
   903	        let safeName = String(cleaned).replacingOccurrences(of: "/", with: "-")
   904	        let ext = doc.url.pathExtension
   905	        let newURL = doc.url.deletingLastPathComponent()
   906	            .appendingPathComponent("\(safeName).\(ext)")
   907	        guard !FileManager.default.fileExists(atPath: newURL.path) else { return nil }
   908	        return newURL
   909	    }

   937	        let relativePath = fileURL.path.replacingOccurrences(

   945	    private static func insertingNode(
   946	        _ target: URL,
   947	        path: [String],
   948	        into nodes: [FileTreeNode]
   949	    ) -> [FileTreeNode] {
   950	        guard let first = path.first else { return nodes }
   951	        let rest = Array(path.dropFirst())
   952	
   953	        for (index, node) in nodes.enumerated() where node.url.lastPathComponent == first {
   954	            if rest.isEmpty {
   955	                return nodes // Already exists
   956	            }
   957	            if node.isDirectory, let children = node.children {
   958	                var updated = nodes
   959	                updated[index] = FileTreeNode(
   960	                    url: node.url,

   118	        )
   119	
   120	        for imageMatch in imagePattern.matches(
   121	            in: attributedText.string, range: fullRange
   122	        ).reversed() {
   123	            let markupRange = imageMatch.range
   124	            let pathRange = imageMatch.range(at: 1)
   125	            guard pathRange.location != NSNotFound,
   126	                  let pathSwiftRange = Range(
   127	                      pathRange, in: attributedText.string
   128	                  ) else { continue }
   129	
   130	            let pathValue = String(
   131	                attributedText.string[pathSwiftRange]
   132	            )
   133	            guard let imageURL = MediaManager.resolvedImageURL(
   134	                from: pathValue,
   135	                baseDirectoryURL: baseDirectoryURL
   136	            ) else { continue }
   137	
   138	            // Parse optional width
   139	            var requestedWidth: CGFloat?
   140	            let widthRange = imageMatch.range(at: 2)
   141	            if widthRange.location != NSNotFound,
   142	               let widthSwiftRange = Range(
   143	                   widthRange, in: attributedText.string
   144	               ),
   145	               let parsed = Int(
   146	                   attributedText.string[widthSwiftRange]
   147	               ) {
   148	                requestedWidth = CGFloat(parsed)
   149	            }
   150	
   151	            let markupText = (attributedText.string as NSString)
   152	                .substring(with: markupRange)
   153	            let cachedImage = WorkspaceImageLoader.shared.cachedImage(
   154	                at: imageURL,
   155	                maxSize: maxSize
   156	            )
   157	            let attachment = NSTextAttachment()
   158	            let displayImage = cachedImage
   159	                ?? NSImage(
   160	                    systemSymbolName: "photo",
   161	                    accessibilityDescription: nil
   162	                )
   163	            attachment.image = displayImage
   164	
   165	            if let width = requestedWidth,
   166	               let img = displayImage,
   167	               img.size.width > 0 {
   168	                let scale = width / img.size.width
   169	                attachment.bounds = CGRect(
   170	                    x: 0, y: 0,
   171	                    width: width,
   172	                    height: img.size.height * scale
   173	                )
   174	            }
   175	
   176	            // Hide the markdown syntax after the first character
   177	            let tailRange = NSRange(
   178	                location: markupRange.location + 1,
   179	                length: markupRange.length - 1
   180	            )
   181	            let hiddenAttributes: [NSAttributedString.Key: Any] = [
   182	                .font: NSFont.systemFont(ofSize: 0.01),
   183	                .foregroundColor: NSColor.clear
   184	            ]
   185	            attributedText.addAttributes(
   186	                hiddenAttributes, range: tailRange
   187	            )
   188	
   189	            // Replace leading "!" with the object replacement
   190	            // character so NSTextView renders the attachment
   191	            let bangRange = NSRange(
   192	                location: markupRange.location, length: 1
   193	            )
   194	            let attachmentStr = NSMutableAttributedString(
   195	                attributedString: NSAttributedString(
   196	                    attachment: attachment
   197	                )
   198	            )
   199	            let attrRange = NSRange(location: 0, length: 1)
   200	            attachmentStr.addAttribute(
   201	                imageURLKey, value: imageURL, range: attrRange
   202	            )
   203	            attachmentStr.addAttribute(
   204	                imageMarkupKey,
   205	                value: markupText,
   206	                range: attrRange
   207	            )
   208	            attributedText.replaceCharacters(
   209	                in: bangRange,
   210	                with: attachmentStr
   211	            )
   212	
   213	            pendingRenders.append(
   214	                PendingImageRender(
   215	                    imageURL: imageURL,
   216	                    markupRange: markupRange,
   217	                    markupText: markupText,
   218	                    attachmentRange: bangRange
   219	                )
   220	            )
   221	        }
   222	
   223	        return pendingRenders
   224	    }

   226	    /// Restore object replacement characters back to `!` so the
   227	    /// underlying plain text stays valid markdown.
   228	    static func restoreImageMarkup(in text: String) -> String {
   229	        // Short-circuit if no attachment characters present
   230	        guard text.contains(attachmentCharacter) else { return text }
   231	        return text.replacingOccurrences(of: attachmentCharacter, with: "!")
   232	    }

   241	    /// Parse `=WIDTHx` from image markup like `![alt](path =300x)`.
   242	    static func parseImageWidth(from markup: String) -> CGFloat? {
   243	        guard let range = markup.range(of: #"=(\d+)x\)$"#, options: .regularExpression),
   244	              let numRange = markup.range(of: #"\d+"#, options: .regularExpression, range: range)
   245	        else { return nil }
   246	        return CGFloat(Int(markup[numRange]) ?? 0)
   247	    }
   248	
   249	    /// Return new markup with the width set or updated.
   250	    static func markupWithWidth(
   251	        _ markup: String, width: Int
   252	    ) -> String {
   253	        // Remove existing =WIDTHx if present
   254	        var cleaned = markup.replacingOccurrences(
   255	            of: #"\s+=\d+x\)"#,
   256	            with: ")",
   257	            options: .regularExpression
   258	        )
   259	        // Insert =WIDTHx before closing paren
   260	        if let parenIndex = cleaned.lastIndex(of: ")") {
   261	            cleaned.insert(
   262	                contentsOf: " =\(width)x",
   263	                at: parenIndex
   264	            )
   265	        }
   266	        return cleaned
   267	    }

   273	    // swiftlint:disable:next function_body_length
   274	    private func applyInlineFormatting(_ str: NSMutableAttributedString, baseFont: NSFont) {
   275	        // MARK: Wiki links [[Note Title]]
   276	        // Must run BEFORE bold/italic so link content isn't further reformatted
   277	        let wikiRange = NSRange(location: 0, length: str.string.utf16.count)
   278	        for match in Self.wikiPattern.matches(in: str.string, range: wikiRange).reversed() {
   279	            let fullNSRange = match.range
   280	            let innerNSRange = match.range(at: 1)
   281	            guard let innerSwiftRange = Range(innerNSRange, in: str.string) else { continue }
   282	            let noteTitle = String(str.string[innerSwiftRange])
   283	            // Skip empty or whitespace-only links
   284	            if noteTitle.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespaces).isEmpty { continue }
   285	            let encodedTitle = noteTitle.addingPercentEncoding(
   286	                withAllowedCharacters: .urlPathAllowed
   287	            ) ?? noteTitle
   288	            // swiftlint:disable:next force_unwrapping
   289	            let linkURL = URL(string: "synth://wiki/\(encodedTitle)")!
   290	
   291	            // Style inner text as link
   292	            let linkAttrs: [NSAttributedString.Key: Any] = [
   293	                .foregroundColor: NSColor.controlAccentColor,
   294	                .link: linkURL,
   295	                .cursor: NSCursor.pointingHand
   296	            ]
   297	            str.addAttributes(linkAttrs, range: innerNSRange)
   298	
   299	            // Style [[ and ]] brackets in gray (FSNotes style)
   300	            let bracketAttrs: [NSAttributedString.Key: Any] = [
   301	                .foregroundColor: NSColor.gray,
   302	                .link: linkURL
   303	            ]
   304	            let openRange = NSRange(location: fullNSRange.location, length: 2)
   305	            let closeRange = NSRange(
   306	                location: fullNSRange.location + fullNSRange.length - 2,
   307	                length: 2
   308	            )
   309	            str.addAttributes(bracketAttrs, range: openRange)
   310	            str.addAttributes(bracketAttrs, range: closeRange)
   311	        }
   312	
   313	        // MARK: @Date mentions (@2026-02-07) — styled as daily note links
   314	        let dateRange = NSRange(
   315	            location: 0, length: str.string.utf16.count
   316	        )
   317	        for match in Self.datePattern.matches(
   318	            in: str.string, range: dateRange
   319	        ).reversed() {
   320	            let fullNSRange = match.range
   321	            let innerNSRange = match.range(at: 1)
   322	            guard let innerSwiftRange = Range(
   323	                innerNSRange, in: str.string
   324	            ) else { continue }
   325	            let dateStr = String(str.string[innerSwiftRange])
   326	            // swiftlint:disable:next force_unwrapping
   327	            let linkURL = URL(string: "synth://daily/\(dateStr)")!
   328	            // Style the date part as a link
   329	            let linkAttrs: [NSAttributedString.Key: Any] = [
   330	                .font: Theme.editorNSFont(
   331	                    ofSize: baseFont.pointSize,
   332	                    weight: .medium
   333	                ),
   334	                .foregroundColor: NSColor.controlAccentColor,
   335	                .link: linkURL,
   336	                .cursor: NSCursor.pointingHand
   337	            ]
   338	            str.addAttributes(linkAttrs, range: innerNSRange)
   339	
   340	            // Hide the @ prefix
   341	            let hiddenAttrs: [NSAttributedString.Key: Any] = [
   342	                .font: NSFont.systemFont(ofSize: 0.01),
   343	                .foregroundColor: NSColor.clear,
   344	                .link: linkURL
   345	            ]
   346	            str.addAttributes(
   347	                hiddenAttrs,
   348	                range: NSRange(
   349	                    location: fullNSRange.location, length: 1
   350	                )
   351	            )
   352	        }
   353	        // MARK: @People mentions
   354	        let personPattern = PeopleIndex.personPattern
   355	        let personRange = NSRange(location: 0, length: str.string.utf16.count)
   356	        for match in personPattern.matches(in: str.string, range: personRange).reversed() {
   357	            let fullNSRange = match.range
   358	            let innerNSRange = match.range(at: 1)
   359	            guard let innerSwiftRange = Range(innerNSRange, in: str.string) else { continue }
   360	            let personName = String(str.string[innerSwiftRange])
   361	            guard personName.count >= 2 else { continue }
   362	            let personLower = personName.lowercased()
   363	            // swiftlint:disable:next force_unwrapping
   364	            let personURL = URL(string: "synth://person/\(personLower)")!
   365	            let mediumFont = Theme.editorNSFont(
   366	                ofSize: baseFont.pointSize,
   367	                weight: .medium
   368	            )
   369	            let replacement = NSAttributedString(
   370	                string: "@\(personName)",
   371	                attributes: [
   372	                    .font: mediumFont,
   373	                    .foregroundColor: NSColor.systemPurple,
   374	                    .backgroundColor: NSColor.systemPurple.withAlphaComponent(0.10),
   375	                    .link: personURL,
   376	                    .cursor: NSCursor.pointingHand
   377	                ]
   378	            )
   379	            str.replaceCharacters(in: fullNSRange, with: replacement)
   380	        }
   381	
   382	        // MARK: #Tags
   383	        // Must run after wiki links and @dates, before bold/italic/code
   384	        let tagPattern = TagIndex.tagPattern
   385	        let tagRange = NSRange(location: 0, length: str.string.utf16.count)
   386	        for match in tagPattern.matches(in: str.string, range: tagRange).reversed() {
   387	            let fullNSRange = match.range
   388	            let innerNSRange = match.range(at: 1)
   389	            guard let innerSwiftRange = Range(innerNSRange, in: str.string) else { continue }
   390	            let tagName = String(str.string[innerSwiftRange])
   391	            guard tagName.count >= 2 else { continue }
   392	            let tagLower = tagName.lowercased()
   393	            // swiftlint:disable:next force_unwrapping
   394	            let tagURL = URL(string: "synth://tag/\(tagLower)")!
   395	            let mediumFont = Theme.editorNSFont(
   396	                ofSize: baseFont.pointSize,
   397	                weight: .medium
   398	            )
   399	            let replacement = NSAttributedString(
   400	                string: "#\(tagName)",
   401	                attributes: [
   402	                    .font: mediumFont,
   403	                    .foregroundColor: NSColor.systemTeal,
   404	                    .backgroundColor: NSColor.systemTeal.withAlphaComponent(0.10),
   405	                    .link: tagURL,
   406	                    .cursor: NSCursor.pointingHand
   407	                ]
   408	            )
   409	            str.replaceCharacters(in: fullNSRange, with: replacement)
   410	        }
   411	
   412	        // Hidden marker attributes
   413	        let hiddenAttrs: [NSAttributedString.Key: Any] = [
   414	            .font: NSFont.systemFont(ofSize: 0.01),
   415	            .foregroundColor: NSColor.clear
   416	        ]
   417	
   418	        // MARK: Bold **text** — style inner text, hide markers
   419	        let boldRange = NSRange(location: 0, length: str.string.utf16.count)
   420	        for match in Self.boldPattern.matches(in: str.string, range: boldRange).reversed() {
   421	            let fullRange = match.range
   422	            let innerRange = match.range(at: 1)
   423	            let boldFont = NSFontManager.shared.convert(
   424	                baseFont, toHaveTrait: .boldFontMask
   425	            )
   426	            str.addAttribute(.font, value: boldFont, range: innerRange)
   427	            // Gray ** markers (FSNotes style)
   428	            let openRange = NSRange(location: fullRange.location, length: 2)
   429	            let closeRange = NSRange(location: fullRange.location + fullRange.length - 2, length: 2)
   430	            str.addAttribute(.foregroundColor, value: NSColor.gray, range: openRange)
   431	            str.addAttribute(.foregroundColor, value: NSColor.gray, range: closeRange)
   432	        }
   433	
   434	        // MARK: Italic *text* — style inner text, gray markers
   435	        let italicRange = NSRange(location: 0, length: str.string.utf16.count)
   436	        for match in Self.italicPattern.matches(in: str.string, range: italicRange).reversed() {
   437	            let fullRange = match.range
   438	            let innerRange = match.range(at: 1)
   439	            let italicFont = NSFontManager.shared.convert(
   440	                baseFont, toHaveTrait: .italicFontMask
   441	            )
   442	            str.addAttribute(.font, value: italicFont, range: innerRange)
   443	            // Gray * markers (FSNotes style)
   444	            let openRange = NSRange(location: fullRange.location, length: 1)
   445	            let closeRange = NSRange(location: fullRange.location + fullRange.length - 1, length: 1)
   446	            str.addAttribute(.foregroundColor, value: NSColor.gray, range: openRange)
   447	            str.addAttribute(.foregroundColor, value: NSColor.gray, range: closeRange)
   448	        }
   449	
   450	        // MARK: Underline __text__ — style inner text, gray markers
   451	        let underlineRange = NSRange(location: 0, length: str.string.utf16.count)
   452	        for match in Self.underlinePattern.matches(in: str.string, range: underlineRange).reversed() {
   453	            let fullRange = match.range
   454	            let innerRange = match.range(at: 1)
   455	            str.addAttribute(
   456	                .underlineStyle,
   457	                value: NSUnderlineStyle.single.rawValue,
   458	                range: innerRange
   459	            )
   460	            // Gray __ markers (FSNotes style)
   461	            let openRange = NSRange(location: fullRange.location, length: 2)
   462	            let closeRange = NSRange(location: fullRange.location + fullRange.length - 2, length: 2)
   463	            str.addAttribute(.foregroundColor, value: NSColor.gray, range: openRange)
   464	            str.addAttribute(.foregroundColor, value: NSColor.gray, range: closeRange)
   465	        }
   466	
   467	        // MARK: Inline code `text` — style inner text, gray backticks
   468	        let codeRange = NSRange(location: 0, length: str.string.utf16.count)
   469	        for match in Self.codePattern.matches(in: str.string, range: codeRange).reversed() {
   470	            let fullRange = match.range
   471	            let innerRange = match.range(at: 1)
   472	            str.addAttributes([
   473	                .font: Theme.terminalNSFont(ofSize: 14),
   474	                .foregroundColor: NSColor.systemPink,
   475	                .backgroundColor: NSColor.quaternaryLabelColor
   476	            ], range: innerRange)
   477	            // Gray ` markers (FSNotes style)
   478	            let openRange = NSRange(location: fullRange.location, length: 1)
   479	            let closeRange = NSRange(location: fullRange.location + fullRange.length - 1, length: 1)
   480	            str.addAttribute(.foregroundColor, value: NSColor.gray, range: openRange)
   481	            str.addAttribute(.foregroundColor, value: NSColor.gray, range: closeRange)
   482	        }
   483	    }
   484	}

   759	    override func mouseDragged(with event: NSEvent) {
   760	        guard isResizeDragging,
   761	              let charIndex = hoveredImageCharIndex,
   762	              let storage = textStorage,
   763	              charIndex < storage.length
   764	        else {
   765	            if !isResizeDragging {
   766	                super.mouseDragged(with: event)
   767	            }
   768	            return
   769	        }
   770	
   771	        // Hide copy/delete during resize
   772	        if !imageOverlay.isHidden { imageOverlay.isHidden = true }
   773	
   774	        let point = convert(event.locationInWindow, from: nil)
   775	        let delta = point.x - resizeDragStartX
   776	        let newWidth = max(80, resizeDragStartWidth + delta)
   777	        let newHeight = newWidth / resizeDragAspectRatio
   778	
   779	        guard let oldAttachment = storage.attribute(
   780	            .attachment, at: charIndex, effectiveRange: nil
   781	        ) as? NSTextAttachment else { return }
   782	
   783	        let newAttachment = NSTextAttachment()
   784	        newAttachment.image = oldAttachment.image
   785	        newAttachment.bounds = CGRect(
   786	            x: 0, y: 0, width: newWidth, height: newHeight
   787	        )
   788	        let replacement = NSMutableAttributedString(
   789	            attributedString: NSAttributedString(
   790	                attachment: newAttachment
   791	            )
   792	        )
   793	        let attrRange = NSRange(location: 0, length: 1)
   794	        if let url = hoveredImageURL {
   795	            replacement.addAttribute(
   796	                MarkdownFormat.imageURLKey,
   797	                value: url, range: attrRange
   798	            )
   799	        }
   800	        if let markup = hoveredImageMarkup {
   801	            replacement.addAttribute(
   802	                MarkdownFormat.imageMarkupKey,
   803	                value: markup, range: attrRange
   804	            )
   805	        }
   806	        let charRange = NSRange(location: charIndex, length: 1)
   807	        storage.replaceCharacters(in: charRange, with: replacement)
   808	
   809	        // Reposition grip after layout updates
   810	        layoutManager?.ensureLayout(
   811	            forCharacterRange: charRange
   812	        )
   813	        if let glyphRange = layoutManager?.glyphRange(
   814	            forCharacterRange: charRange,
   815	            actualCharacterRange: nil
   816	        ), let textContainer = textContainer {
   817	            let glyphRect = layoutManager?.boundingRect(
   818	                forGlyphRange: glyphRange, in: textContainer
   819	            ) ?? .zero
   820	            let newRect = CGRect(
   821	                x: glyphRect.origin.x + textContainerInset.width,
   822	                y: glyphRect.origin.y + textContainerInset.height,
   823	                width: glyphRect.width,
   824	                height: glyphRect.height
   825	            )
   826	            resizeHandle.frame = resizeHandleRect(for: newRect)
   827	        }
   828	    }

   845	    private func updateImageOverlay(for event: NSEvent) {
   846	        let point = convert(event.locationInWindow, from: nil)
   847	
   848	        // Don't dismiss if mouse is over the overlay or resize handle
   849	        if !imageOverlay.isHidden {
   850	            let overlayPoint = imageOverlay.convert(
   851	                event.locationInWindow, from: nil

   854	            let handlePoint = resizeHandle.convert(
   855	                event.locationInWindow, from: nil

   858	        }
   859	
   860	        guard let imageURL = imageURL(at: point),
   861	              let attachRect = attachmentRect(at: point)
   862	        else {
   863	            if !imageOverlay.isHidden {
   864	                imageOverlay.isHidden = true
   865	                resizeHandle.isHidden = true
   866	                hoveredImageURL = nil
   867	                hoveredImageMarkup = nil
   868	                hoveredImageRect = nil
   869	                hoveredImageCharIndex = nil
   870	            }
   871	            return
   872	        }
   873	        hoveredImageURL = imageURL
   874	        hoveredImageRect = attachRect
   875	        hoveredImageMarkup = imageMarkup(at: point)
   876	        hoveredImageCharIndex = charIndex(at: point)
   877	
   878	        let overlaySize = CGSize(width: 64, height: 28)
   879	        imageOverlay.frame = CGRect(

   942	    private func attachmentRect(at point: CGPoint) -> CGRect? {
   943	        guard let layoutManager = layoutManager,
   944	              let textContainer = textContainer
   945	        else { return nil }

   947	            x: point.x - textContainerInset.width,
   948	            y: point.y - textContainerInset.height
   949	        )
   950	        let glyphIndex = layoutManager.glyphIndex(
   951	            for: textPoint, in: textContainer

   954	        let lineRect = layoutManager.lineFragmentRect(
   955	            forGlyphAt: glyphIndex, effectiveRange: &lineRange
   956	        )
   957	        let glyphRect = layoutManager.boundingRect(
   958	            forGlyphRange: NSRange(location: glyphIndex, length: 1),
   959	            in: textContainer
   960	        )

   962	            x: glyphRect.origin.x + textContainerInset.width,
   963	            y: lineRect.origin.y + textContainerInset.height,
   964	            width: glyphRect.width,
   965	            height: lineRect.height
   966	        )
   967	        // Only return if the point is actually inside the image area
   968	        guard rect.contains(point), rect.height > 20 else { return nil }
   969	        return rect

   997	    // Regex for unordered list markers: -, *, +, •, >, –, —
   998	    // swiftlint:disable:next force_try
   999	    private static let listMarkerRegex = try! NSRegularExpression(
  1000	        pattern: #"^([ \t]*)([-*+•>–—])( )"#
  1001	    )
  1002	    // Regex for ordered list: 1. 2. etc
  1003	    // swiftlint:disable:next force_try

  1008	    override func insertNewline(_ sender: Any?) {
  1009	        // Dismiss wiki link popup on newline
  1010	        switch wikiLinkState {
  1011	        case .wikiLinkActive, .atActive, .hashtagActive, .slashActive:
  1012	            wikiLinkState = .idle
  1013	            NotificationCenter.default.post(name: .wikiLinkDismiss, object: self)
  1014	        default:
  1015	            break
  1016	        }
  1017	
  1018	        guard let storage = textStorage else { super.insertNewline(sender); return }
  1019	        let lineRange = (storage.string as NSString).lineRange(for: selectedRange())
  1020	        let line = (storage.string as NSString).substring(with: lineRange).trimmingCharacters(in: .newlines)
  1021	        let nsLine = line as NSString
  1022	        let fullRange = NSRange(location: 0, length: nsLine.length)
  1023	
  1024	        // Check for unordered list marker
  1025	        if let match = Self.listMarkerRegex.firstMatch(in: line, range: fullRange) {
  1026	            let prefix = nsLine.substring(with: match.range)
  1027	            // If line is just the marker, remove it
  1028	            if line == prefix.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespaces) {
  1029	                storage.replaceCharacters(in: lineRange, with: "")
  1030	                return
  1031	            }
  1032	            super.insertNewline(sender)
  1033	            insertText(prefix, replacementRange: selectedRange())
  1034	            return
  1035	        }
  1036	
  1037	        // Check for numbered list
  1038	        if let match = Self.numberedListRegex.firstMatch(in: line, range: fullRange) {
  1039	            let indentRange = match.range(at: 1)
  1040	            let numRange = match.range(at: 2)
  1041	            let dotRange = match.range(at: 3)
  1042	            let indent = nsLine.substring(with: indentRange)
  1043	            let numStr = nsLine.substring(with: numRange)
  1044	            let dot = nsLine.substring(with: dotRange)
  1045	            let prefix = "\(indent)\(numStr)\(dot)"
  1046	
  1047	            // If line is just the marker, remove it
  1048	            if line == prefix.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespaces) {
  1049	                storage.replaceCharacters(in: lineRange, with: "")
  1050	                return
  1051	            }
  1052	            // Increment number
  1053	            if let num = Int(numStr) {
  1054	                let nextPrefix = "\(indent)\(num + 1)\(dot)"
  1055	                super.insertNewline(sender)
  1056	                insertText(nextPrefix, replacementRange: selectedRange())
  1057	                return
  1058	            }
  1059	        }
  1060	
  1061	        super.insertNewline(sender)
  1062	    }

  1073	    private func handleAutocompleteState(for str: String) {
  1074	        switch wikiLinkState {
  1075	        case .idle:
  1076	            handleIdleState(for: str)
  1077	        case .singleBracket:
  1078	            handleSingleBracketState(for: str)
  1079	        case .wikiLinkActive, .atActive:
  1080	            handleLinkActiveState(for: str)
  1081	        case .hashtagActive(let start):
  1082	            handleHashtagActiveState(for: str, start: start)

  1088	    private func handleIdleState(for str: String) {
  1089	        if str == "[" {
  1090	            wikiLinkState = .singleBracket
  1091	        } else if str == "@" {
  1092	            let start = selectedRange().location
  1093	            wikiLinkState = .atActive(start: start)
  1094	            NotificationCenter.default.post(
  1095	                name: .wikiLinkTrigger,
  1096	                object: self,
  1097	                userInfo: ["mode": "at", "query": ""]
  1098	            )
  1099	        } else if str == "#" {
  1100	            if isAutocompleteTriggerAllowed() {
  1101	                wikiLinkState = .hashtagActive(start: cursor)
  1102	            }
  1103	        } else if str == "/" {
  1104	            if isAutocompleteTriggerAllowed() {
  1105	                wikiLinkState = .slashActive(start: cursor)
  1106	                NotificationCenter.default.post(
  1107	                    name: .wikiLinkTrigger,
  1108	                    object: self,
  1109	                    userInfo: ["mode": "template", "query": ""]
  1110	                )
  1111	            }
  1112	        }
  1113	    }

  1115	    private var cursor: Int {
  1116	        selectedRange().location

  1119	    private func isAutocompleteTriggerAllowed() -> Bool {
  1120	        if cursor <= 1 {
  1121	            return true
  1122	        }
  1123	        guard let storage = textStorage else {
  1124	            return false
  1125	        }
  1126	        let textValue = storage.string as NSString
  1127	        let previousChar = textValue.substring(
  1128	            with: NSRange(location: cursor - 2, length: 1)
  1129	        )
  1130	        return previousChar.rangeOfCharacter(from: .whitespacesAndNewlines) != nil
  1131	    }

  1147	    private func handleLinkActiveState(for str: String) {

  1150	            NotificationCenter.default.post(name: .wikiLinkDismiss, object: self)
  1151	        } else if str == " " {

  1155	            } else {
  1156	                postQueryUpdate()
  1157	            }
  1158	        } else {
  1159	            postQueryUpdate()

  1162	
  1163	    private func handleHashtagActiveState(for str: String, start: Int) {

  1181	            } else {

  1184	        }

  1276	    // MARK: - Extract Current Query
  1277	
  1278	    func extractCurrentQuery() -> String {
  1279	        guard let storage = textStorage else { return "" }
  1280	        let cursor = selectedRange().location
  1281	        switch wikiLinkState {
  1282	        case .wikiLinkActive(let start), .atActive(let start), .hashtagActive(let start), .slashActive(let start):
  1283	            guard cursor > start else { return "" }
  1284	            let range = NSRange(location: start, length: cursor - start)

  1325	    private func toggleMarkdownWrap(_ marker: String) {
  1326	        guard textStorage != nil else { return }
  1327	        let range = selectedRange()
  1328	        let text = (textStorage!.string as NSString)
  1329	        let markerLen = marker.count
  1330	
  1331	        if range.length > 0 {
  1332	            guard range.location + range.length <= text.length else { return }
  1333	            let selected = text.substring(with: range)
  1334	
  1335	            // Check if already wrapped
  1336	            let hasBefore = range.location >= markerLen
  1337	                && text.substring(with: NSRange(location: range.location - markerLen, length: markerLen)) == marker
  1338	            let hasAfter = range.location + range.length + markerLen <= text.length
  1339	                && text.substring(with: NSRange(location: range.location + range.length, length: markerLen)) == marker
  1340	
  1341	            if hasBefore && hasAfter {
  1342	                // Remove markers
  1343	                let fullRange = NSRange(location: range.location - markerLen, length: range.length + markerLen * 2)
  1344	                insertText(selected, replacementRange: fullRange)
  1345	                setSelectedRange(NSRange(location: range.location - markerLen, length: range.length))
  1346	            } else {
  1347	                // Add markers
  1348	                let wrapped = "\(marker)\(selected)\(marker)"
  1349	                insertText(wrapped, replacementRange: range)
  1350	                setSelectedRange(NSRange(location: range.location + markerLen, length: range.length))
  1351	            }
  1352	        } else {
  1353	            // No selection — insert empty markers and place cursor inside
  1354	            insertText("\(marker)\(marker)", replacementRange: range)
  1355	            setSelectedRange(NSRange(location: range.location + markerLen, length: 0))
  1356	        }
  1357	    }

  1361	    struct AutocompleteResult {
  1362	        let completedWikiLink: Bool
  1363	        let completedPerson: Bool

  1367	    func completeAutocomplete(title: String) -> AutocompleteResult {
  1368	        guard let storage = textStorage else {
  1369	            return AutocompleteResult(
  1370	                completedWikiLink: false,
  1371	                completedPerson: false,
  1372	                completedDate: false
  1373	            )
  1374	        }
  1375	        let cursor = selectedRange().location
  1376	        let previousState = wikiLinkState
  1377	        var didCompletePerson = false
  1378	        var didCompleteDate = false
  1379	
  1380	        switch wikiLinkState {
  1381	        case .wikiLinkActive(let start):
  1382	            let replaceStart = max(start - 2, 0)
  1383	            let range = NSRange(
  1384	                location: replaceStart,
  1385	                length: cursor - replaceStart
  1386	            )
  1387	            let replacement = "[[\(title)]]"
  1388	            storage.replaceCharacters(in: range, with: replacement)
  1389	            setSelectedRange(NSRange(
  1390	                location: replaceStart + replacement.count,
  1391	                length: 0
  1392	            ))
  1393	
  1394	        case .atActive(let start):
  1395	            let replaceStart = max(start - 1, 0)
  1396	            let range = NSRange(
  1397	                location: replaceStart,
  1398	                length: cursor - replaceStart
  1399	            )
  1400	            let isDateToken = DailyNoteResolver.resolveDate(
  1401	                title
  1402	            ) != nil
  1403	            let isPerson = !isDateToken
  1404	            let displayTitle = isPerson
  1405	                ? title.titleCased : title
  1406	            let replacement = isPerson
  1407	                ? "@\(displayTitle) " : "@\(title) "
  1408	            storage.replaceCharacters(
  1409	                in: range, with: replacement
  1410	            )
  1411	            setSelectedRange(NSRange(
  1412	                location: replaceStart + replacement.count,
  1413	                length: 0
  1414	            ))
  1415	            didCompletePerson = isPerson
  1416	            didCompleteDate = isDateToken
  1417	
  1418	        case .hashtagActive(let start):
  1419	            let replaceStart = max(start - 1, 0)
  1420	            let range = NSRange(
  1421	                location: replaceStart,
  1422	                length: cursor - replaceStart
  1423	            )
  1424	            let tagText = title.hasPrefix("#")
  1425	                ? title : "#\(title)"
  1426	            let replacement = "\(tagText) "
  1427	            storage.replaceCharacters(
  1428	                in: range, with: replacement
  1429	            )
  1430	            setSelectedRange(NSRange(
  1431	                location: replaceStart + replacement.count,
  1432	                length: 0
  1433	            ))
  1434	
  1435	        case .slashActive(let start):
  1436	            let replaceStart = max(start - 1, 0)
  1437	            let range = NSRange(
  1438	                location: replaceStart,
  1439	                length: cursor - replaceStart
  1440	            )
  1441	            storage.replaceCharacters(in: range, with: title)
  1442	            setSelectedRange(NSRange(
  1443	                location: replaceStart + title.count,
  1444	                length: 0
  1445	            ))
  1446	
  1447	        default:
  1448	            break
  1449	        }
  1450	
  1451	        wikiLinkState = .idle
  1452	
  1453	        let wasWikiLink: Bool
  1454	        if case .wikiLinkActive = previousState {
  1455	            wasWikiLink = true
  1456	        } else {
  1457	            wasWikiLink = false
  1458	        }
  1459	
  1460	        return AutocompleteResult(
  1461	            completedWikiLink: wasWikiLink,
  1462	            completedPerson: didCompletePerson,
  1463	            completedDate: didCompleteDate
  1464	        )
  1465	    }
  1466	}

  1720	        private func removeImageMarkup(for imageURL: URL) {
  1721	            guard let textView = textView else { return }
  1722	            let filename = imageURL.lastPathComponent
  1723	            let text = MarkdownFormat.restoreImageMarkup(
  1724	                in: textView.string

  1726	            // swiftlint:disable:next force_try
  1727	            let pattern = try! NSRegularExpression(
  1728	                pattern: "!\\[[^\\]]*\\]\\([^)]*"
  1729	                    + NSRegularExpression.escapedPattern(for: filename)
  1730	                    + "(?:\\s+=\\d+x)?\\)\\n?"

  1733	            guard let match = pattern.firstMatch(
  1734	                in: text,

  1736	            ) else { return }

  1738	                in: match.range, with: ""

  1740	            textView.string = cleaned

  1764	        // MARK: - Line Positions
  1765	
  1766	        private var lastNewlineCount = 0
  1767	
  1768	        func updateLinePositions() {
  1769	            guard let textView = textView,
  1770	                  let layoutManager = textView.layoutManager,
  1771	                  let textContainer = textView.textContainer else { return }
  1772	
  1773	            let string = textView.string
  1774	
  1775	            // Quick newline count — O(n) but fast single pass
  1776	            var newlineCount = 0
  1777	            for char in string where char == "\n" { newlineCount += 1 }
  1778	
  1779	            // Skip if newline count unchanged (most keystrokes don't add/remove lines)
  1780	            if newlineCount == lastNewlineCount && !parent.linePositions.isEmpty {
  1781	                return
  1782	            }
  1783	            lastNewlineCount = newlineCount
  1784	
  1785	            layoutManager.ensureLayout(for: textContainer)
  1786	
  1787	            let textInset = textView.textContainerInset.height
  1788	            let baseFont = Theme.editorNSFont(ofSize: 16)
  1789	            var positions: [CGFloat] = []
  1790	            let nsString = string as NSString
  1791	            let length = nsString.length
  1792	
  1793	            if length == 0 {
  1794	                positions.append(textInset + baseFont.pointSize / 2)
  1795	                parent.linePositions = positions
  1796	                return
  1797	            }
  1798	
  1799	            // Walk logical lines, use layout rect for accurate Y
  1800	            var charIndex = 0
  1801	            while charIndex < length {
  1802	                let glyphIndex = layoutManager.glyphIndexForCharacter(
  1803	                    at: charIndex
  1804	                )
  1805	                var lineRange = NSRange()
  1806	                let rect = layoutManager.lineFragmentRect(
  1807	                    forGlyphAt: glyphIndex,
  1808	                    effectiveRange: &lineRange
  1809	                )
  1810	                positions.append(textInset + rect.midY)
  1811	
  1812	                // Advance to next line
  1813	                let lineEnd = NSMaxRange(
  1814	                    nsString.lineRange(for: NSRange(
  1815	                        location: charIndex, length: 0
  1816	                    ))
  1817	                )
  1818	                charIndex = lineEnd == charIndex ? charIndex + 1 : lineEnd
  1819	            }
  1820	
  1821	            // Trailing newline produces an empty last line with no
  1822	            // characters — use extraLineFragmentRect for its position
  1823	            let extraRect = layoutManager.extraLineFragmentRect
  1824	            if extraRect.height > 0 {
  1825	                positions.append(textInset + extraRect.midY)
  1826	            }
  1827	
  1828	            DispatchQueue.main.async {
  1829	                self.parent.linePositions = positions
  1830	            }
  1831	        }

   421	            let fullRange = match.range
   422	            let innerRange = match.range(at: 1)
   423	            let boldFont = NSFontManager.shared.convert(
   424	                baseFont, toHaveTrait: .boldFontMask
   425	            )
   426	            str.addAttribute(.font, value: boldFont, range: innerRange)
   427	            // Gray ** markers (FSNotes style)
   428	            let openRange = NSRange(location: fullRange.location, length: 2)
   429	            let closeRange = NSRange(location: fullRange.location + fullRange.length - 2, length: 2)
   430	            str.addAttribute(.foregroundColor, value: NSColor.gray, range: openRange)
   431	            str.addAttribute(.foregroundColor, value: NSColor.gray, range: closeRange)
   432	        }
   433	
   434	        // MARK: Italic *text* — style inner text, gray markers
   435	        let italicRange = NSRange(location: 0, length: str.string.utf16.count)
   436	        for match in Self.italicPattern.matches(in: str.string, range: italicRange).reversed() {
   437	            let fullRange = match.range
   438	            let innerRange = match.range(at: 1)
   439	            let italicFont = NSFontManager.shared.convert(
   440	                baseFont, toHaveTrait: .italicFontMask
   441	            )
   442	            str.addAttribute(.font, value: italicFont, range: innerRange)
   443	            // Gray * markers (FSNotes style)
   444	            let openRange = NSRange(location: fullRange.location, length: 1)
   445	            let closeRange = NSRange(location: fullRange.location + fullRange.length - 1, length: 1)
   446	            str.addAttribute(.foregroundColor, value: NSColor.gray, range: openRange)
   447	            str.addAttribute(.foregroundColor, value: NSColor.gray, range: closeRange)
   448	        }
   449	
   450	        // MARK: Underline __text__ — style inner text, gray markers
   451	        let underlineRange = NSRange(location: 0, length: str.string.utf16.count)
   452	        for match in Self.underlinePattern.matches(in: str.string, range: underlineRange).reversed() {
   453	            let fullRange = match.range
   454	            let innerRange = match.range(at: 1)
   455	            str.addAttribute(
   456	                .underlineStyle,
   457	                value: NSUnderlineStyle.single.rawValue,
   458	                range: innerRange
   459	            )
   460	            // Gray __ markers (FSNotes style)
   461	            let openRange = NSRange(location: fullRange.location, length: 2)
   462	            let closeRange = NSRange(location: fullRange.location + fullRange.length - 2, length: 2)
   463	            str.addAttribute(.foregroundColor, value: NSColor.gray, range: openRange)
   464	            str.addAttribute(.foregroundColor, value: NSColor.gray, range: closeRange)
   465	        }
   466	
   467	        // MARK: Inline code `text` — style inner text, gray backticks
   468	        let codeRange = NSRange(location: 0, length: str.string.utf16.count)
   469	        for match in Self.codePattern.matches(in: str.string, range: codeRange).reversed() {
   470	            let fullRange = match.range
   471	            let innerRange = match.range(at: 1)
   472	            str.addAttributes([
   473	                .font: Theme.terminalNSFont(ofSize: 14),
   474	                .foregroundColor: NSColor.systemPink,
   475	                .backgroundColor: NSColor.quaternaryLabelColor
   476	            ], range: innerRange)
   477	            // Gray ` markers (FSNotes style)
   478	            let openRange = NSRange(location: fullRange.location, length: 1)
   479	            let closeRange = NSRange(location: fullRange.location + fullRange.length - 1, length: 1)
   480	            str.addAttribute(.foregroundColor, value: NSColor.gray, range: openRange)
   481	            str.addAttribute(.foregroundColor, value: NSColor.gray, range: closeRange)
   482	        }
   483	    }
   484	}

   764	        else {
   765	            if !isResizeDragging {
   766	                super.mouseDragged(with: event)
   767	            }
   768	            return
   769	        }
   770	
   771	        // Hide copy/delete during resize
   772	        if !imageOverlay.isHidden { imageOverlay.isHidden = true }
   773	
   774	        let point = convert(event.locationInWindow, from: nil)
   775	        let delta = point.x - resizeDragStartX
   776	        let newWidth = max(80, resizeDragStartWidth + delta)
   777	        let newHeight = newWidth / resizeDragAspectRatio
   778	
   779	        guard let oldAttachment = storage.attribute(
   780	            .attachment, at: charIndex, effectiveRange: nil
   781	        ) as? NSTextAttachment else { return }
   782	
   783	        let newAttachment = NSTextAttachment()
   784	        newAttachment.image = oldAttachment.image
   785	        newAttachment.bounds = CGRect(
   786	            x: 0, y: 0, width: newWidth, height: newHeight
   787	        )
   788	        let replacement = NSMutableAttributedString(
   789	            attributedString: NSAttributedString(
   790	                attachment: newAttachment
   791	            )
   792	        )
   793	        let attrRange = NSRange(location: 0, length: 1)
   794	        if let url = hoveredImageURL {
   795	            replacement.addAttribute(
   796	                MarkdownFormat.imageURLKey,
   797	                value: url, range: attrRange
   798	            )
   799	        }
   800	        if let markup = hoveredImageMarkup {
   801	            replacement.addAttribute(
   802	                MarkdownFormat.imageMarkupKey,
   803	                value: markup, range: attrRange
   804	            )
   805	        }
   806	        let charRange = NSRange(location: charIndex, length: 1)
   807	        storage.replaceCharacters(in: charRange, with: replacement)
   808	
   809	        // Reposition grip after layout updates
   810	        layoutManager?.ensureLayout(
   811	            forCharacterRange: charRange
   812	        )
   813	        if let glyphRange = layoutManager?.glyphRange(
   814	            forCharacterRange: charRange,
   815	            actualCharacterRange: nil
   816	        ), let textContainer = textContainer {
   817	            let glyphRect = layoutManager?.boundingRect(
   818	                forGlyphRange: glyphRange, in: textContainer
   819	            ) ?? .zero
   820	            let newRect = CGRect(
   821	                x: glyphRect.origin.x + textContainerInset.width,
   822	                y: glyphRect.origin.y + textContainerInset.height,
   823	                width: glyphRect.width,
   824	                height: glyphRect.height
   825	            )

   827	        }
   828	    }

   860	        guard let imageURL = imageURL(at: point),

   867	                hoveredImageMarkup = nil
   868	                hoveredImageRect = nil
   869	                hoveredImageCharIndex = nil
   870	            }
   871	            return
   872	        }

   874	        hoveredImageRect = attachRect
   875	        hoveredImageMarkup = imageMarkup(at: point)

   916	        guard let idx, idx < textStorage.length else { return nil }
   917	        return textStorage.attribute(

   924	    private func charIndex(at point: CGPoint) -> Int? {
   925	        guard let textStorage = textStorage,
   926	              let layoutManager = layoutManager,
   927	              let textContainer = textContainer
   928	        else { return nil }
   929	        let textPoint = CGPoint(
   930	            x: point.x - textContainerInset.width,
   931	            y: point.y - textContainerInset.height
   932	        )
   933	        let idx = layoutManager.characterIndex(
   934	            for: textPoint,
   935	            in: textContainer,
   936	            fractionOfDistanceBetweenInsertionPoints: nil
   937	        )
   938	        guard idx < textStorage.length else { return nil }
   939	        return idx
   940	    }
   941	
   942	    private func attachmentRect(at point: CGPoint) -> CGRect? {
   943	        guard let layoutManager = layoutManager,
   944	              let textContainer = textContainer
   945	        else { return nil }
   946	        let textPoint = CGPoint(
   947	            x: point.x - textContainerInset.width,
   948	            y: point.y - textContainerInset.height
   949	        )
   950	        let glyphIndex = layoutManager.glyphIndex(
   951	            for: textPoint, in: textContainer
   952	        )
   953	        var lineRange = NSRange()
   954	        let lineRect = layoutManager.lineFragmentRect(
   955	            forGlyphAt: glyphIndex, effectiveRange: &lineRange
   956	        )
   957	        let glyphRect = layoutManager.boundingRect(
   958	            forGlyphRange: NSRange(location: glyphIndex, length: 1),
   959	            in: textContainer
   960	        )
   961	        let rect = CGRect(
   962	            x: glyphRect.origin.x + textContainerInset.width,
   963	            y: lineRect.origin.y + textContainerInset.height,
   964	            width: glyphRect.width,
   965	            height: lineRect.height
   966	        )
   967	        // Only return if the point is actually inside the image area
   968	        guard rect.contains(point), rect.height > 20 else { return nil }
   969	        return rect
   970	    }

  1008	    override func insertNewline(_ sender: Any?) {
  1009	        // Dismiss wiki link popup on newline
  1010	        switch wikiLinkState {
  1011	        case .wikiLinkActive, .atActive, .hashtagActive, .slashActive:
  1012	            wikiLinkState = .idle
  1013	            NotificationCenter.default.post(name: .wikiLinkDismiss, object: self)
  1014	        default:
  1015	            break
  1016	        }
  1017	
  1018	        guard let storage = textStorage else { super.insertNewline(sender); return }
  1019	        let lineRange = (storage.string as NSString).lineRange(for: selectedRange())
  1020	        let line = (storage.string as NSString).substring(with: lineRange).trimmingCharacters(in: .newlines)
  1021	        let nsLine = line as NSString
  1022	        let fullRange = NSRange(location: 0, length: nsLine.length)
  1023	
  1024	        // Check for unordered list marker
  1025	        if let match = Self.listMarkerRegex.firstMatch(in: line, range: fullRange) {
  1026	            let prefix = nsLine.substring(with: match.range)
  1027	            // If line is just the marker, remove it
  1028	            if line == prefix.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespaces) {
  1029	                storage.replaceCharacters(in: lineRange, with: "")
  1030	                return
  1031	            }
  1032	            super.insertNewline(sender)
  1033	            insertText(prefix, replacementRange: selectedRange())
  1034	            return
  1035	        }
  1036	
  1037	        // Check for numbered list
  1038	        if let match = Self.numberedListRegex.firstMatch(in: line, range: fullRange) {
  1039	            let indentRange = match.range(at: 1)
  1040	            let numRange = match.range(at: 2)
  1041	            let dotRange = match.range(at: 3)
  1042	            let indent = nsLine.substring(with: indentRange)
  1043	            let numStr = nsLine.substring(with: numRange)
  1044	            let dot = nsLine.substring(with: dotRange)
  1045	            let prefix = "\(indent)\(numStr)\(dot)"
  1046	
  1047	            // If line is just the marker, remove it
  1048	            if line == prefix.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespaces) {
  1049	                storage.replaceCharacters(in: lineRange, with: "")
  1050	                return
  1051	            }
  1052	            // Increment number
  1053	            if let num = Int(numStr) {
  1054	                let nextPrefix = "\(indent)\(num + 1)\(dot)"
  1055	                super.insertNewline(sender)
  1056	                insertText(nextPrefix, replacementRange: selectedRange())
  1057	                return
  1058	            }
  1059	        }
  1060	
  1061	        super.insertNewline(sender)
  1062	    }

  1325	    private func toggleMarkdownWrap(_ marker: String) {
  1326	        guard textStorage != nil else { return }
  1327	        let range = selectedRange()
  1328	        let text = (textStorage!.string as NSString)
  1329	        let markerLen = marker.count
  1330	
  1331	        if range.length > 0 {
  1332	            guard range.location + range.length <= text.length else { return }
  1333	            let selected = text.substring(with: range)
  1334	
  1335	            // Check if already wrapped
  1336	            let hasBefore = range.location >= markerLen
  1337	                && text.substring(with: NSRange(location: range.location - markerLen, length: markerLen)) == marker
  1338	            let hasAfter = range.location + range.length + markerLen <= text.length
  1339	                && text.substring(with: NSRange(location: range.location + range.length, length: markerLen)) == marker
  1340	
  1341	            if hasBefore && hasAfter {
  1342	                // Remove markers
  1343	                let fullRange = NSRange(location: range.location - markerLen, length: range.length + markerLen * 2)
  1344	                insertText(selected, replacementRange: fullRange)
  1345	                setSelectedRange(NSRange(location: range.location - markerLen, length: range.length))
  1346	            } else {
  1347	                // Add markers
  1348	                let wrapped = "\(marker)\(selected)\(marker)"
  1349	                insertText(wrapped, replacementRange: range)
  1350	                setSelectedRange(NSRange(location: range.location + markerLen, length: range.length))
  1351	            }
  1352	        } else {
  1353	            // No selection — insert empty markers and place cursor inside
  1354	            insertText("\(marker)\(marker)", replacementRange: range)
  1355	            setSelectedRange(NSRange(location: range.location + markerLen, length: 0))
  1356	        }
  1357	    }

  1376	        let previousState = wikiLinkState
  1377	        var didCompletePerson = false
  1378	        var didCompleteDate = false
  1379	
  1380	        switch wikiLinkState {

  1393

  1404	            let displayTitle = isPerson

  1406	            let replacement = isPerson

  1408	            storage.replaceCharacters(
  1409	                in: range, with: replacement
  1410	            )
  1411	            setSelectedRange(NSRange(

  1415	            didCompletePerson = isPerson

  1417	
  1418	        case .hashtagActive(let start):

  1429	            )
  1430	            setSelectedRange(NSRange(
  1431	                location: replaceStart + replacement.count,

  1433	            ))
  1434	
  1435	        case .slashActive(let start):

   133	            url: url,
   134	            title: existing.title,
   135	            relativePath: existing.relativePath,
   136	            content: content,
   137	            modifiedAt: modifiedAt
   138	        )
   139	        allNotes[noteIndex] = updated
   140	        updateDocumentFrequency(previous: previous, updated: updated)
   141	        notes = allNotes.map(\.result)
   142	    }
