   144	    func search(_ query: String) -> [NoteSearchResult] {
   145	        let trimmedQuery = query.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines)
   146	        if trimmedQuery.isEmpty {
   147	            return Array(allNotes.prefix(20).map(\.result))
   148	        }
   149	
   150	        let parsedQuery = Self.parseQuery(trimmedQuery)
   151	        let expandedTokens = Set(Self.expandQueryTokens(parsedQuery.queryTokens))
   152	
   153	        let ranked: [(NoteSearchResult, Int)] = allNotes
   154	            .compactMap { indexed -> (NoteSearchResult, Int)? in
   155	                guard matchesFilters(indexed, query: parsedQuery) else { return nil }
   156	                let rank = score(
   157	                    indexed,
   158	                    parsedQuery: parsedQuery,
   159	                    queryTokens: expandedTokens
   160	                )
   161	                guard rank > 0 else { return nil }
   162	                let preview = Self.preview(
   163	                    from: indexed,
   164	                    normalizedQuery: parsedQuery.normalizedQuery,
   165	                    queryTokens: expandedTokens
   166	                )
   167	                let result = NoteSearchResult(
   168	                    id: indexed.result.id,
   169	                    title: indexed.result.title,
   170	                    relativePath: indexed.result.relativePath,
   171	                    url: indexed.result.url,
   172	                    preview: preview,
   173	                    score: rank
   174	                )
   175	                return (result, rank)
   176	            }
   177	
   178	        return ranked
   179	            .sorted { first, second in
   180	                if first.1 == second.1 {
   181	                    return first.0.title.localizedCaseInsensitiveCompare(second.0.title) == .orderedAscending
   182	                }
   183	                return first.1 > second.1
   184	            }
   185	            .map { $0.0 }
   186	    }

   192	    private func rebuildDocumentFrequency() {
   193	        var frequency: [String: Int] = [:]
   194	        for note in allNotes {
   195	            let uniqueTokens = uniqueTokens(for: note)
   196	            for token in uniqueTokens {
   197	                frequency[token, default: 0] += 1
   198	            }
   199	        }
   200	        documentFrequency = frequency
   201	    }

   203	    private func updateDocumentFrequency(previous: IndexedNote, updated: IndexedNote) {
   204	        let previousTokens = uniqueTokens(for: previous)
   205	        let updatedTokens = uniqueTokens(for: updated)
   206	        let removedTokens = previousTokens.subtracting(updatedTokens)
   207	        let addedTokens = updatedTokens.subtracting(previousTokens)
   208	
   209	        for token in removedTokens {
   210	            let currentCount = documentFrequency[token] ?? 0
   211	            if currentCount <= 1 {
   212	                documentFrequency.removeValue(forKey: token)
   213	            } else {
   214	                documentFrequency[token] = currentCount - 1
   215	            }
   216	        }
   217	
   218	        for token in addedTokens {
   219	            documentFrequency[token, default: 0] += 1
   220	        }
   221	    }

   223	    private func uniqueTokens(for note: IndexedNote) -> Set<String> {
   224	        Set(note.titleTokens).union(note.contentTokenCounts.keys)

   227	    private func score(
   228	        _ indexed: IndexedNote,
   229	        parsedQuery: ParsedQuery,
   230	        queryTokens: Set<String>
   231	    ) -> Int {
   232	        let query = parsedQuery.displayQuery
   233	        let normalizedQuery = parsedQuery.normalizedQuery
   234	        let normalizedPhrases = parsedQuery.normalizedPhrases
   235	        let hasSearchTerms = parsedQuery.hasSearchTerms
   236	        var total = recencyBoost(for: indexed.modifiedAt)
   237	        var relevanceSignals = 0
   238	        let lowerQuery = query.lowercased()
   239	
   240	        if !normalizedQuery.isEmpty && indexed.normalizedTitle == normalizedQuery {
   241	            total += Self.ScoreWeights.exactTitleMatch
   242	            relevanceSignals += 1
   243	        } else if !normalizedQuery.isEmpty && indexed.normalizedTitle.contains(normalizedQuery) {
   244	            total += Self.ScoreWeights.partialTitleMatch
   245	            relevanceSignals += 1
   246	        }
   247	
   248	        if !normalizedQuery.isEmpty && indexed.normalizedContent.contains(normalizedQuery) {
   249	            total += Self.ScoreWeights.exactContentMatch
   250	            relevanceSignals += 1
   251	        }
   252	
   253	        if !lowerQuery.isEmpty, let titleFuzzy = indexed.result.title.fuzzyScore(lowerQuery) {
   254	            total += titleFuzzy * Self.ScoreWeights.titleFuzzyMultiplier
   255	            relevanceSignals += 1
   256	        }
   257	
   258	        for phrase in normalizedPhrases where !phrase.isEmpty {
   259	            if indexed.normalizedTitle.contains(phrase) {
   260	                total += Self.ScoreWeights.titlePhraseMatch
   261	                relevanceSignals += 1
   262	            }
   263	            if indexed.normalizedContent.contains(phrase) {
   264	                total += Self.ScoreWeights.contentPhraseMatch
   265	                relevanceSignals += 1
   266	            }
   267	        }
   268	
   269	        for token in queryTokens {
   270	            let inverseDocumentWeight = inverseDocumentFrequency(for: token)
   271	            let tokenWeight = max(inverseDocumentWeight, 1)
   272	            if indexed.titleTokens.contains(token) {
   273	                total += Self.ScoreWeights.titleTokenMatch * tokenWeight
   274	                relevanceSignals += 1
   275	            } else if indexed.titleTokens.contains(where: { $0.hasPrefix(token) || token.hasPrefix($0) }) {
   276	                total += Self.ScoreWeights.titlePrefixTokenMatch * tokenWeight
   277	                relevanceSignals += 1
   278	            }
   279	
   280	            let frequency = indexed.contentTokenCounts[token] ?? 0
   281	            if frequency > 0 {
   282	                total += min(frequency, Self.ScoreWeights.maxContentFrequencyCount)
   283	                    * Self.ScoreWeights.contentTokenMatch
   284	                    * tokenWeight
   285	                relevanceSignals += 1
   286	            }
   287	        }
   288	
   289	        let matchedTokenCount = queryTokens.filter { token in
   290	            indexed.titleTokens.contains(token) || indexed.contentTokenCounts[token] != nil
   291	        }.count
   292	
   293	        if matchedTokenCount == queryTokens.count && !queryTokens.isEmpty {
   294	            total += Self.ScoreWeights.allTokensMatchBonus
   295	        } else if matchedTokenCount > 0 {
   296	            total += matchedTokenCount * Self.ScoreWeights.partialTokenMatchBonus
   297	        }
   298	
   299	        if !hasSearchTerms {
   300	            total += Self.ScoreWeights.filterOnlyQueryBonus
   301	        }
   302	
   303	        if hasSearchTerms && relevanceSignals == 0 {
   304	            return 0
   305	        }
   306	
   307	        return total
   308	    }

   310	    private func matchesFilters(_ indexed: IndexedNote, query: ParsedQuery) -> Bool {
   311	        if !query.requiredTags.isEmpty {
   312	            for filterTag in query.requiredTags where !containsTag(filterTag, in: indexed.tags) {
   313	                return false
   314	            }
   315	        }
   316	
   317	        if !query.requiredPeople.isEmpty {
   318	            for filterPerson in query.requiredPeople where !containsPerson(filterPerson, in: indexed.mentions) {
   319	                return false
   320	            }
   321	        }
   322	
   323	        if !query.requiredPaths.isEmpty {
   324	            let path = indexed.result.relativePath.lowercased()
   325	            for requiredPath in query.requiredPaths where !path.contains(requiredPath) {
   326	                return false
   327	            }
   328	        }
   329	
   330	        if !query.normalizedPhrases.isEmpty {
   331	            for phrase in query.normalizedPhrases {
   332	                let inTitle = indexed.normalizedTitle.contains(phrase)
   333	                let inContent = indexed.normalizedContent.contains(phrase)
   334	                if !inTitle && !inContent {
   335	                    return false
   336	                }
   337	            }
   338	        }
   339	
   340	        return true
   341	    }

   343	    private func containsTag(_ filterTag: String, in tags: Set<String>) -> Bool {
   344	        tags.contains(filterTag) || tags.contains(where: { $0.hasPrefix(filterTag) })
   345	    }
   346	
   347	    private func containsPerson(_ filterPerson: String, in people: Set<String>) -> Bool {
   348	        people.contains(filterPerson) || people.contains(where: { $0.hasPrefix(filterPerson) })
   349	    }

   351	    private func recencyBoost(for modifiedAt: Date) -> Int {
   352	        let daysAgo = Date().timeIntervalSince(modifiedAt) / 86_400
   353	        switch daysAgo {
   354	        case ..<1:
   355	            return Self.RecencyWeights.lastDay
   356	        case ..<7:
   357	            return Self.RecencyWeights.lastWeek
   358	        case ..<30:
   359	            return Self.RecencyWeights.lastMonth
   360	        default:
   361	            return 0
   362	        }
   363	    }
   364	
   365	    private func inverseDocumentFrequency(for token: String) -> Int {
   366	        let documents = max(allNotes.count, 1)
   367	        let occurrences = max(documentFrequency[token] ?? 0, 1)
   368	        let ratio = Double(documents) / Double(occurrences)
   369	        switch ratio {
   370	        case ..<1.5:
   371	            return 1
   372	        case ..<3.0:
   373	            return 2
   374	        case ..<6.0:
   375	            return 3
   376	        default:
   377	            return 4
   378	        }
   379	    }

   381	    private static func flatten(_ nodes: [FileTreeNode], workspace: URL?) -> [IndexedNote] {
   382	        var result: [IndexedNote] = []
   383	        for node in nodes {
   384	            if !node.isDirectory {
   385	                let fileExt = node.url.pathExtension.lowercased()
   386	                if searchableExtensions.contains(fileExt) {
   387	                    let title = node.url.deletingPathExtension().lastPathComponent
   388	                    let relativePath = relativeDirectory(for: node.url, workspace: workspace)
   389	                    let content = (try? String(contentsOf: node.url, encoding: .utf8)) ?? ""
   390	                    let values = try? node.url.resourceValues(forKeys: [.contentModificationDateKey])
   391	                    let modifiedAt = values?.contentModificationDate ?? Date.distantPast
   392	                    result.append(
   393	                        makeIndexedNote(
   394	                            url: node.url,
   395	                            title: title,
   396	                            relativePath: relativePath,
   397	                            content: content,
   398	                            modifiedAt: modifiedAt
   399	                        )
   400	                    )
   401	                }
   402	            }
   403	            if let children = node.children {
   404	                result.append(contentsOf: flatten(children, workspace: workspace))
   405	            }
   406	        }
   407	        return result
   408	    }

   410	    private static func makeIndexedNote(
   411	        url: URL,
   412	        title: String,
   413	        relativePath: String,
   414	        content: String,
   415	        modifiedAt: Date
   416	    ) -> IndexedNote {
   417	        let titleTokens = tokens(from: title)
   418	        let contentTokens = tokens(from: content)
   419	        let tags = extractTags(from: content)
   420	        let mentions = extractMentions(from: content)
   421	
   422	        var contentTokenCounts: [String: Int] = [:]
   423	        for token in contentTokens {
   424	            contentTokenCounts[token, default: 0] += 1
   425	        }
   426	
   427	        let previewLines = cleanedPreviewLines(from: content)
   428	        let defaultPreview = previewLines.first ?? "No preview available."
   429	
   430	        let result = NoteSearchResult(
   431	            id: url,
   432	            title: title,
   433	            relativePath: relativePath,
   434	            url: url,
   435	            preview: defaultPreview
   436	        )
   437	        return IndexedNote(
   438	            result: result,
   439	            normalizedTitle: normalizeText(title),
   440	            normalizedContent: normalizeText(content),
   441	            titleTokens: titleTokens,
   442	            contentTokenCounts: contentTokenCounts,
   443	            previewLines: previewLines,
   444	            tags: tags,
   445	            mentions: mentions,
   446	            modifiedAt: modifiedAt
   447	        )
   448	    }

   450	    private static func preview(
   451	        from indexed: IndexedNote,
   452	        normalizedQuery: String,
   453	        queryTokens: Set<String>
   454	    ) -> String {
   455	        let lines = indexed.previewLines
   456	        guard !lines.isEmpty else { return "No preview available." }
   457	
   458	        var bestScore = Int.min
   459	        var bestLine = lines[0]
   460	
   461	        for line in lines {
   462	            let normalizedLine = normalizeText(line)
   463	            var lineScore = 0
   464	
   465	            if !normalizedQuery.isEmpty && normalizedLine.contains(normalizedQuery) {
   466	                lineScore += 1_200
   467	            }
   468	
   469	            for token in queryTokens where normalizedLine.contains(token) {
   470	                lineScore += 150
   471	            }
   472	
   473	            if lineScore > bestScore {
   474	                bestScore = lineScore
   475	                bestLine = line
   476	            }
   477	        }
   478	
   479	        return truncatedPreview(bestLine, limit: 200)
   480	    }

   482	    private static func cleanedPreviewLines(from content: String) -> [String] {
   483	        content
   484	            .components(separatedBy: .newlines)
   485	            .map(cleanPreviewLine)
   486	            .filter { !$0.isEmpty }
   487	    }

   489	    private static func cleanPreviewLine(_ line: String) -> String {
   490	        let withoutListSyntax = line.replacingOccurrences(
   491	            of: #"^\s{0,3}(#{1,6}|[-*+]|>\s?)\s*"#,
   492	            with: "",
   493	            options: .regularExpression
   494	        )
   495	        let withoutInlineCode = withoutListSyntax.replacingOccurrences(of: "`", with: "")
   496	        let collapsed = withoutInlineCode.replacingOccurrences(
   497	            of: #"\s+"#,
   498	            with: " ",
   499	            options: .regularExpression
   500	        )
   501	        return collapsed.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines)
   502	    }
   503	
   504	    private static func truncatedPreview(_ text: String, limit: Int) -> String {
   505	        guard text.count > limit else { return text }
   506	        let cutoffIndex = text.index(text.startIndex, offsetBy: limit)
   507	        return "\(text[..<cutoffIndex])..."
   508	    }

   510	    private static func relativeDirectory(for fileURL: URL, workspace: URL?) -> String {
   511	        guard let workspace else {
   512	            return fileURL.deletingLastPathComponent().lastPathComponent
   513	        }
   514	
   515	        let directoryURL = fileURL.deletingLastPathComponent().standardizedFileURL
   516	        let workspaceURL = workspace.standardizedFileURL
   517	        let workspacePrefix = workspaceURL.path + "/"
   518	        let directoryPath = directoryURL.path
   519	
   520	        if directoryPath == workspaceURL.path {
   521	            return "root"
   522	        }
   523	        if directoryPath.hasPrefix(workspacePrefix) {
   524	            return String(directoryPath.dropFirst(workspacePrefix.count))
   525	        }
   526	        return directoryURL.lastPathComponent
   527	    }

   529	    private static func parseQuery(_ query: String) -> ParsedQuery {
   530	        let (fragments, phrases) = splitFragments(query)
   531	        var rawTerms: [String] = []
   532	        var requiredTags: Set<String> = []
   533	        var requiredPeople: Set<String> = []
   534	        var requiredPaths: [String] = []
   535	
   536	        for fragment in fragments {
   537	            if let pathFilter = parseFilter(fragment, key: "path")
   538	                ?? parseFilter(fragment, key: "in") {
   539	                requiredPaths.append(pathFilter.lowercased())
   540	                continue
   541	            }
   542	
   543	            if let tagFilter = parseFilter(fragment, key: "tag") {
   544	                requiredTags.insert(tagFilter)
   545	                continue
   546	            }
   547	            if let personFilter = parseFilter(fragment, key: "person")
   548	                ?? parseFilter(fragment, key: "people")
   549	                ?? parseFilter(fragment, key: "mention") {
   550	                requiredPeople.insert(personFilter)
   551	                continue
   552	            }
   553	
   554	            if fragment.hasPrefix("#"), let tagFilter = normalizeTag(fragment) {
   555	                requiredTags.insert(tagFilter)
   556	                continue
   557	            }
   558	            if fragment.hasPrefix("@"), let personFilter = normalizePerson(fragment) {
   559	                requiredPeople.insert(personFilter)
   560	                continue
   561	            }
   562	
   563	            rawTerms.append(fragment)
   564	        }
   565	
   566	        let normalizedPhrases = phrases.map(normalizeText).filter { !$0.isEmpty }
   567	        let phraseTokens = phrases.flatMap(tokens(from:))
   568	        let termTokens = rawTerms.flatMap(tokens(from:)) + phraseTokens
   569	        let displayQuery = (rawTerms + phrases).joined(separator: " ").trimmingCharacters(
   570	            in: .whitespacesAndNewlines
   571	        )
   572	        let normalizedQuery = normalizeText(displayQuery)
   573	
   574	        return ParsedQuery(
   575	            displayQuery: displayQuery,
   576	            normalizedQuery: normalizedQuery,
   577	            queryTokens: termTokens,
   578	            normalizedPhrases: normalizedPhrases,
   579	            requiredTags: requiredTags,
   580	            requiredPeople: requiredPeople,
   581	            requiredPaths: requiredPaths
   582	        )
   583	    }

   585	    private static func splitFragments(_ query: String) -> ([String], [String]) {
   586	        var fragments: [String] = []
   587	        var phrases: [String] = []
   588	        var current = ""
   589	        var inQuote = false
   590	
   591	        for character in query {
   592	            if character == "\"" {
   593	                if inQuote {
   594	                    let phrase = current.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines)
   595	                    if !phrase.isEmpty {
   596	                        phrases.append(phrase)
   597	                    }
   598	                    current = ""
   599	                } else if !current.isEmpty {
   600	                    fragments.append(contentsOf: splitWords(current))
   601	                    current = ""
   602	                }
   603	                inQuote.toggle()
   604	                continue
   605	            }
   606	            current.append(character)
   607	        }
   608	
   609	        if !current.isEmpty {
   610	            fragments.append(contentsOf: splitWords(current))
   611	        }
   612	
   613	        return (fragments, phrases)
   614	    }
   615	
   616	    private static func splitWords(_ text: String) -> [String] {
   617	        text
   618	            .split { $0.isWhitespace }
   619	            .map(String.init)
   620	            .filter { !$0.isEmpty }
   621	    }
   622	
   623	    private static func parseFilter(_ fragment: String, key: String) -> String? {
   624	        let parts = fragment.split(separator: ":", maxSplits: 1).map(String.init)
   625	        guard parts.count == 2,
   626	              parts[0].lowercased() == key.lowercased() else { return nil }
   627	        let value = parts[1].trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines)
   628	        guard !value.isEmpty else { return nil }
   629	        if key == "path" || key == "in" {
   630	            return value.lowercased()
   631	        }
   632	        if key == "tag" {
   633	            return normalizeTag(value)
   634	        }
   635	        return normalizePerson(value)
   636	    }
   637	
   638	    private static func normalizeTag(_ rawTag: String) -> String? {
   639	        let cleaned = rawTag.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines)
   640	            .trimmingCharacters(in: CharacterSet(charactersIn: "#"))
   641	            .lowercased()
   642	        guard cleaned.count >= 2 else { return nil }
   643	        let allowed = cleaned.replacingOccurrences(
   644	            of: "[^a-z0-9_-]",
   645	            with: "",
   646	            options: .regularExpression
   647	        )
   648	        guard !allowed.isEmpty else { return nil }
   649	        return allowed
   650	    }
   651	
   652	    private static func normalizePerson(_ rawPerson: String) -> String? {
   653	        let cleaned = rawPerson.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines)
   654	            .trimmingCharacters(in: CharacterSet(charactersIn: "@"))
   655	            .lowercased()
   656	        guard cleaned.count >= 2 else { return nil }
   657	        let collapsed = cleaned.replacingOccurrences(
   658	            of: "\\s+",
   659	            with: " ",
   660	            options: .regularExpression
   661	        )
   662	        guard !collapsed.isEmpty else { return nil }
   663	        return collapsed
   664	    }

   666	    private static func extractTags(from content: String) -> Set<String> {
   667	        guard let regex = tagPattern else { return [] }
   668	        let searchRange = NSRange(content.startIndex..<content.endIndex, in: content)
   669	        let matches = regex.matches(in: content, range: searchRange)
   670	        var tags: Set<String> = []
   671	        for match in matches {
   672	            guard let range = Range(match.range(at: 1), in: content) else { continue }
   673	            if let tag = normalizeTag(String(content[range])) {
   674	                tags.insert(tag)
   675	            }
   676	        }
   677	        return tags
   678	    }
   679	
   680	    private static func extractMentions(from content: String) -> Set<String> {
   681	        guard let regex = mentionPattern else { return [] }
   682	        let searchRange = NSRange(content.startIndex..<content.endIndex, in: content)
   683	        let matches = regex.matches(in: content, range: searchRange)
   684	        var mentions: Set<String> = []
   685	        for match in matches {
   686	            guard let range = Range(match.range(at: 1), in: content) else { continue }
   687	            if let mention = normalizePerson(String(content[range])) {
   688	                mentions.insert(mention)
   689	            }
   690	        }
   691	        return mentions
   692	    }

   694	    private static func tokens(from text: String) -> [String] {
   695	        text
   696	            .lowercased()
   697	            .components(separatedBy: CharacterSet.alphanumerics.inverted)
   698	            .compactMap(normalizeToken(_:))
   699	    }
   700	
   701	    private static func normalizeText(_ text: String) -> String {
   702	        tokens(from: text).joined(separator: " ")
   703	    }
   704	
   705	    private static func normalizeToken(_ rawToken: String) -> String? {
   706	        let trimmed = rawToken.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines)
   707	        guard trimmed.count >= 2 else { return nil }
   708	        return stem(trimmed)
   709	    }
   710	
   711	    private static func stem(_ token: String) -> String {
   712	        var stemmed = token
   713	        if stemmed.hasSuffix("ies") && stemmed.count > 4 {
   714	            stemmed.removeLast(3)
   715	            stemmed.append("y")
   716	            return stemmed
   717	        }
   718	        if stemmed.hasSuffix("ing") && stemmed.count > 5 {
   719	            stemmed.removeLast(3)
   720	            return stemmed
   721	        }
   722	        if stemmed.hasSuffix("ed") && stemmed.count > 4 {
   723	            stemmed.removeLast(2)
   724	            return stemmed
   725	        }
   726	        if stemmed.hasSuffix("ly") && stemmed.count > 4 {
   727	            stemmed.removeLast(2)
   728	            return stemmed
   729	        }
   730	        if stemmed.hasSuffix("es") && stemmed.count > 4 {
   731	            stemmed.removeLast(2)
   732	            return stemmed
   733	        }
   734	        if stemmed.hasSuffix("s") && stemmed.count > 3 {
   735	            stemmed.removeLast(1)
   736	            return stemmed
   737	        }
   738	        return stemmed
   739	    }

   741	    private static func expandQueryTokens(_ queryTokens: [String]) -> [String] {
   742	        var expanded: Set<String> = []
   743	        for token in queryTokens {
   744	            expanded.insert(token)
   745	            if let semanticTokens = semanticMap[token] {
   746	                expanded.formUnion(semanticTokens)
   747	            }
   748	        }
   749	        return Array(expanded)

### 1. File Tree Scanning - Synchronous I/O on Main Thread
**Location:** `FileTreeNode.swift:18-42`

**Issue:** The `scan()` method performs synchronous file system I/O on the main thread, which can cause UI freezes with large workspaces.

```swift
    guard let contents = try? FileManager.default.contentsOfDirectory(
        at: url, includingPropertiesForKeys: keys
    ) else { return [] }
    // ... synchronous recursive scan
```

**Recommendation:**

- Use a streaming approach that emits partial results
- Cache resource values instead of fetching them multiple times per file

**Implementation Sketch:**

```swift
static func scanAsync(_ url: URL) async -> [FileTreeNode] {

    }.value
```

### 2. Index Rebuilding - Reading All Files Synchronously
**Location:** `NoteIndex.swift:381-408`, `BacklinkIndex.swift:24-43`, `TagIndex.swift:31-47`, `PeopleIndex.swift:52-74`

**Issue:** All four indexes (NoteIndex, BacklinkIndex, TagIndex, PeopleIndex) read file contents synchronously during rebuild:

```swift
for file in files {
    guard let content = try? String(contentsOf: file.url, encoding: .utf8) else { continue }
    // process content...
}
```

**Recommendation:**
- Parallelize file reading using `withTaskGroup`
- Use `FileHandle` with buffered reading for large files
- Implement lazy content loading - only read full content when needed for search
- Consider a unified file scanner that all indexes share (single pass)

**Implementation Sketch:**

```swift
func rebuildAsync(fileTree: [FileTreeNode]) async {
    await withTaskGroup(of: (URL, String?).self) { group in
        for file in files {
            group.addTask {
                (file.url, try? String(contentsOf: file.url, encoding: .utf8))
            }
        }
        for await (url, content) in group {
            if let content { processFile(url, content) }
        }
    }
}
```

### 3. Redundant Index Rebuilds - Quadruple Rebuild on Workspace Events
**Location:** `DocumentStore.swift:523-529`

**Issue:** When applying scan results, four separate rebuilds occur:

```swift
private func applyScanResult(_ scanResult: WorkspaceScanResult, workspace: URL) {
    fileTree = scanResult.tree
    noteIndex.rebuild(from: scanResult.tree, workspace: workspace)  // Reads all files
    mediaFiles = scanResult.media
    backlinkIndex.rebuild(fileTree: scanResult.tree)                // Reads all files AGAIN
    tagIndex.rebuild(fileTree: scanResult.tree)                     // Reads all files AGAIN
    peopleIndex.rebuild(fileTree: scanResult.tree)                  // Reads all files AGAIN
}
```

**Recommendation:**
- Implement a **unified indexer** that reads each file once and populates all indexes in a single pass
- Create a `FileContent` cache during rebuild that indexes can share

```swift
func applyScanResult(_ result: UnifiedScanResult, workspace: URL) {
    noteIndex.rebuild(from: result.tree, contents: result.fileContents, workspace: workspace)
    backlinkIndex.rebuild(fileTree: result.tree, contents: result.fileContents)
    tagIndex.rebuild(fileTree: result.tree, contents: result.fileContents)
```

**Location:** `MarkdownEditor.swift:1878-1980`

**Recommendation:**

- Use a coalesced update with debouncing for rapid typing

```swift
    formatDebouncer = DispatchWorkItem { [weak self] in
```

### 5. Line Position Calculation - O(n) Recalculation
**Location:** `MarkdownEditor.swift:1768-1831`

**Issue:** Line positions are recalculated by iterating through all lines, even when the newline count hasn't changed:

```swift
func updateLinePositions() {
    var newlineCount = 0
    for char in string where char == "\n" { newlineCount += 1 }  // O(n)
    
    if newlineCount == lastNewlineCount && !parent.linePositions.isEmpty {
        return  // Early exit, but still did O(n) work
```

**Recommendation:**
- Track inserted/deleted ranges and update incrementally
- Maintain a running newline count instead of counting each time
- Use `NSLayoutManager` notifications for line fragment changes

```swift
    // ... synchronous file read
}
```

**Recommendation:**
- Pre-compute and cache content previews during index rebuild
- Load previews asynchronously with `Task.detached`

### 7. Image Loading - No Memory Pressure Handling
**Location:** `DocumentStore.swift:167-253`

**Issue:** `WorkspaceImageLoader` uses `NSCache` but doesn't implement memory pressure handling or size limits:

```swift

// No countLimit or totalCostLimit set
```

**Recommendation:**
- Set cache limits based on available memory
- Implement `NSCacheDelegate` to handle eviction
- Consider using a LRU cache with configurable size

### 8. Orphan Media Cleanup - Full Workspace Enumeration
**Location:** `DocumentStore.swift:541-571`

**Issue:** Cleaning orphaned media enumerates the entire workspace for EACH media file:

```swift
for mediaURL in mediaFiles {
    // Creates a NEW enumerator for each media file
    let enumerator = FileManager.default.enumerator(at: workspace, ...)
    while let fileURL = enumerator?.nextObject() as? URL {
        // Check if content contains filename
    }
}
```

**Recommendation:**
- Build a single set of all referenced media filenames first
- Then check each media file against the set (O(1) lookup vs O(n) enumeration)

**Implementation Sketch:**
```swift
static func cleanOrphanedMedia(mediaFiles: [URL], workspace: URL) -> Set<URL> {
    // Single pass: collect all referenced filenames
    var referencedFilenames: Set<String> = []
    let enumerator = FileManager.default.enumerator(at: workspace, ...)
    while let fileURL = enumerator?.nextObject() as? URL {
        if fileURL.pathExtension == "md",
           let content = try? String(contentsOf: fileURL) {
            // Extract image references and add filenames to set
            referencedFilenames.formUnion(extractImageFilenames(from: content))
        }
    }
    
    // Check each media file against the set
    return Set(mediaFiles.filter { !referencedFilenames.contains($0.lastPathComponent) })
}
```

### 9. Note Search - Linear Scan for Filters
**Location:** `NoteIndex.swift:310-341`

**Issue:** Filter matching iterates through all notes even when filters could narrow results first:

```swift
    }
    
    func invalidate(_ url: URL) {

    }
}
```

   493	        let scanID = UUID()

   497	        fileTreeLoadTask = Task(priority: .userInitiated) { [weak self] in
   498	            let scanResult = Self.scanWorkspace(at: workspace)

   512	                    return

   541	    private static func cleanOrphanedMedia(
   542	        mediaFiles: [URL], workspace: URL
   543	    ) -> Set<URL> {
   544	        var removed: Set<URL> = []
   545	        for mediaURL in mediaFiles {
   546	            let filename = mediaURL.lastPathComponent
   547	            var isReferenced = false
   548	            let enumerator = FileManager.default.enumerator(
   549	                at: workspace,
   550	                includingPropertiesForKeys: [.isDirectoryKey],
   551	                options: [.skipsHiddenFiles]
   552	            )
   553	            while let fileURL = enumerator?.nextObject() as? URL {
   554	                guard fileURL.pathExtension == "md",
   555	                      let content = try? String(
   556	                          contentsOf: fileURL, encoding: .utf8
   557	                      ),
   558	                      content.contains(filename)
   559	                else { continue }
   560	                isReferenced = true
   561	                break
   562	            }
   563	            if !isReferenced {
   564	                try? FileManager.default.trashItem(
   565	                    at: mediaURL, resultingItemURL: nil
   566	                )
   567	                removed.insert(mediaURL)
   568	            }
   569	        }
   570	        return removed
   571	    }

   840	    func saveAll() {
   841	        // Collect documents to save on main thread
   842	        var docsToSave: [(url: URL, content: String, isDocx: Bool, index: Int)] = []
   843	        var renameOps: [(index: Int, oldURL: URL, newURL: URL)] = []
   844	
   845	        for index in openFiles.indices where openFiles[index].isDirty {
   846	            let doc = openFiles[index]
   847	            let isDocx = doc.url.pathExtension.lowercased() == "docx"
   848	
   849	            // For docx, save synchronously (needs attributed string)
   850	            if isDocx {
   851	                try? doc.save(doc.content)
   852	            } else {
   853	                docsToSave.append((doc.url, doc.content.string, isDocx, index))
   854	            }
   855	
   856	            // Check for rename
   857	            if doc.url.lastPathComponent.hasPrefix("Untitled"),
   858	               let newURL = renamedURL(for: doc) {
   859	                renameOps.append((index, doc.url, newURL))
   860	            }
   861	
   862	            openFiles[index].isDirty = false
   863	
   864	            // Update indexes on main thread
   865	            let savedURL = openFiles[index].url
   866	            let savedContent = openFiles[index].content.string
   867	            noteIndex.updateFile(savedURL, content: savedContent)
   868	            backlinkIndex.updateFile(savedURL, content: savedContent)
   869	            tagIndex.updateFile(savedURL, content: savedContent)
   870	            peopleIndex.updateFile(savedURL, content: savedContent)
   871	        }
   872	
   873	        // Background save for plain text files
   874	        if !docsToSave.isEmpty {
   875	            saveQueue.cancelAllOperations()
   876	            let operation = BlockOperation { [docsToSave] in
   877	                for doc in docsToSave {
   878	                    try? doc.content.write(to: doc.url, atomically: true, encoding: .utf8)
   879	                }
   880	            }
   881	            saveQueue.addOperation(operation)
   882	        }
   883	
   884	        // Handle renames on main thread
   885	        for rename in renameOps {
   886	            try? FileManager.default.moveItem(at: rename.oldURL, to: rename.newURL)
   887	            let content = openFiles[rename.index].content
   888	            openFiles[rename.index] = Document(url: rename.newURL, content: content)
   889	        }
   890	        if !renameOps.isEmpty { loadFileTree() }
   891	
   892	        dailyNoteManager.saveAll()
   893	    }

   895	    private func renamedURL(for doc: Document) -> URL? {
   896	        let firstLine = doc.content.string.components(separatedBy: "\n").first ?? ""
   897	        let cleaned = firstLine
   898	            .trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespaces)
   899	            .replacingOccurrences(of: "#", with: "")
   900	            .trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespaces)
   901	            .prefix(50)
   902	        guard !cleaned.isEmpty else { return nil }
   903	        let safeName = String(cleaned).replacingOccurrences(of: "/", with: "-")
   904	        let ext = doc.url.pathExtension
   905	        let newURL = doc.url.deletingLastPathComponent()
   906	            .appendingPathComponent("\(safeName).\(ext)")
   907	        guard !FileManager.default.fileExists(atPath: newURL.path) else { return nil }
   908	        return newURL
   909	    }

   915	    private static func equivalentFileURL(_ firstURL: URL, _ secondURL: URL) -> Bool {
   916	        if firstURL.standardizedFileURL.path == secondURL.standardizedFileURL.path {
   917	            return true
   918	        }
   919	        return canonicalFileURL(firstURL).path == canonicalFileURL(secondURL).path

   928	        return [standardized, canonical]

   935	    func addFileToInMemoryTree(_ fileURL: URL) {
   936	        guard let workspace else { return }
   937	        let relativePath = fileURL.path.replacingOccurrences(
   938	            of: workspace.path + "/", with: ""
   939	        )
   940	        let components = relativePath.split(separator: "/").map(String.init)

   944	
   945	    private static func insertingNode(
   946	        _ target: URL,
   947	        path: [String],
   948	        into nodes: [FileTreeNode]
   949	    ) -> [FileTreeNode] {
   950	        guard let first = path.first else { return nodes }
   951	        let rest = Array(path.dropFirst())
   952	
   953	        for (index, node) in nodes.enumerated() where node.url.lastPathComponent == first {
   954	            if rest.isEmpty {
   955	                return nodes // Already exists
   956	            }
   957	            if node.isDirectory, let children = node.children {
   958	                var updated = nodes
   959	                updated[index] = FileTreeNode(
   960	                    url: node.url,
   961	                    isDirectory: true,
   962	                    children: insertingNode(target, path: rest, into: children)
   963	                )
   964	                return updated
   965	            }
   966	            return nodes
   967	        }
   968	
   969	        // Not found — add new node
   970	        if rest.isEmpty {
   971	            let newNode = FileTreeNode(url: target, isDirectory: false, children: nil)
   972	            return (nodes + [newNode]).sorted { $0.url.lastPathComponent < $1.url.lastPathComponent }
   973	        }
   974	        return nodes
   975	    }
   976	
   977	    private static func removingNode(_ target: URL, from nodes: [FileTreeNode]) -> [FileTreeNode] {
   978	        nodes.compactMap { node in
   979	            if equivalentFileURL(node.url, target) {
   980	                return nil
   981	            }
   982	
   983	            if node.isDirectory, let children = node.children {
   984	                let prunedChildren = removingNode(target, from: children)
   985	                return FileTreeNode(url: node.url, isDirectory: true, children: prunedChildren)
   986	            }
   987	
   988	            return node
   989	        }
   990	    }

   167	final class WorkspaceImageLoader: @unchecked Sendable {
   168	    static let shared = WorkspaceImageLoader()
   169	
   170	    private let decodeQueue = DispatchQueue(
   171	        label: "synth.workspace-image-loader.decode",
   172	        qos: .userInitiated,
   173	        attributes: .concurrent
   174	    )
   175	    private let stateQueue = DispatchQueue(label: "synth.workspace-image-loader.state")
   176	    private let imageCache = NSCache<NSString, NSImage>()
   177	    private var inFlight: [String: [(NSImage?) -> Void]] = [:]
   178	
   179	    private init() {}
   180	
   181	    func cachedImage(at imageURL: URL, maxSize: NSSize) -> NSImage? {
   182	        let cacheKey = key(for: imageURL, maxSize: maxSize)
   183	        return stateQueue.sync {
   184	            imageCache.object(forKey: cacheKey as NSString)
   185	        }
   186	    }
   187	
   188	    func loadImage(at imageURL: URL, maxSize: NSSize, completion: @escaping (NSImage?) -> Void) {
   189	        let cacheKey = key(for: imageURL, maxSize: maxSize)
   190	
   191	        if let cached = cachedImage(at: imageURL, maxSize: maxSize) {
   192	            completion(cached)
   193	            return
   194	        }
   195	
   196	        var shouldStartDecode = false
   197	        stateQueue.sync {
   198	            if var callbacks = inFlight[cacheKey] {
   199	                callbacks.append(completion)
   200	                inFlight[cacheKey] = callbacks
   201	            } else {
   202	                inFlight[cacheKey] = [completion]
   203	                shouldStartDecode = true
   204	            }
   205	        }
   206	
   207	        guard shouldStartDecode else { return }
   208	
   209	        decodeQueue.async {
   210	            let decoded = Self.decodeImage(at: imageURL, maxSize: maxSize)
   211	
   212	            let callbacks: [(NSImage?) -> Void] = self.stateQueue.sync {
   213	                if let decoded {
   214	                    self.imageCache.setObject(decoded, forKey: cacheKey as NSString)
   215	                }
   216	                return self.inFlight.removeValue(forKey: cacheKey) ?? []
   217	            }
   218	
   219	            DispatchQueue.main.async {
   220	                callbacks.forEach { callback in
   221	                    callback(decoded)
   222	                }
   223	            }
   224	        }
   225	    }
   226	
   227	    private func key(for imageURL: URL, maxSize: NSSize) -> String {
   228	        let width = Int(maxSize.width.rounded())
   229	        let height = Int(maxSize.height.rounded())
   230	        return "\(imageURL.path)#\(width)x\(height)"
   231	    }
   232	
   233	    private static func decodeImage(at imageURL: URL, maxSize: NSSize) -> NSImage? {
   234	        guard let source = CGImageSourceCreateWithURL(imageURL as CFURL, nil) else { return nil }
   235	
   236	        let maxPixelSize = max(Int(maxSize.width), Int(maxSize.height))
   237	        let options: [CFString: Any] = [
   238	            kCGImageSourceCreateThumbnailFromImageAlways: true,
   239	            kCGImageSourceCreateThumbnailWithTransform: true,
   240	            kCGImageSourceThumbnailMaxPixelSize: max(maxPixelSize, 1),
   241	            kCGImageSourceShouldCacheImmediately: true
   242	        ]
   243	
   244	        guard let thumbnail = CGImageSourceCreateThumbnailAtIndex(
   245	            source,
   246	            0,
   247	            options as CFDictionary
   248	        ) else { return nil }
   249	
   250	        let imageSize = NSSize(width: thumbnail.width, height: thumbnail.height)
   251	        return NSImage(cgImage: thumbnail, size: imageSize)
   252	    }
   253	}

   365	    private func startWatching() {
   366	        guard let workspace = workspace else { return }
   367	        stopWatching()
   368	
   369	        let context = WorkspaceWatcherContext(store: self)
   370	        watcherContext = context
   371	
   372	        var streamContext = FSEventStreamContext(
   373	            version: 0,
   374	            info: UnsafeMutableRawPointer(Unmanaged.passRetained(context).toOpaque()),
   375	            retain: watcherContextRetain,
   376	            release: watcherContextRelease,
   377	            copyDescription: nil
   378	        )
   379	
   380	        let watchPaths = [workspace.path] as CFArray
   381	        let streamFlags = FSEventStreamCreateFlags(
   382	            kFSEventStreamCreateFlagFileEvents
   383	                | kFSEventStreamCreateFlagNoDefer
   384	                | kFSEventStreamCreateFlagUseCFTypes
   385	        )
   386	
   387	        guard let stream = FSEventStreamCreate(
   388	            kCFAllocatorDefault,
   389	            Self.workspaceEventCallback,
   390	            &streamContext,
   391	            watchPaths,
   392	            FSEventStreamEventId(kFSEventStreamEventIdSinceNow),
   393	            0.2,
   394	            streamFlags
   395	        ) else {
   396	            return
   397	        }
   398	
   399	        FSEventStreamSetDispatchQueue(stream, DispatchQueue.main)
   400	        if FSEventStreamStart(stream) {
   401	            fileEventStream = stream
   402	        } else {
   403	            FSEventStreamInvalidate(stream)
   404	            FSEventStreamRelease(stream)
   405	            watcherContext = nil
   406	        }
   407	    }

   415	        watcherContext = nil

   489	    private func runFileTreeScan(for workspace: URL) {
   490	        guard fileTreeRescanRequested else { return }
   491	        isFileTreeScanRunning = true
   492	        fileTreeRescanRequested = false
   493	        let scanID = UUID()
   494	        activeFileTreeScanID = scanID
   495	
   496	        fileTreeLoadTask?.cancel()
   497	        fileTreeLoadTask = Task(priority: .userInitiated) { [weak self] in
   498	            let scanResult = Self.scanWorkspace(at: workspace)
   499	            guard !Task.isCancelled else { return }
   500	            await MainActor.run {
   501	                guard let self = self else { return }
   502	                guard Self.shouldApplyFileTreeScanResult(
   503	                    activeScanID: self.activeFileTreeScanID,
   504	                    scanID: scanID,
   505	                    currentWorkspace: self.workspace,
   506	                    scanWorkspace: workspace
   507	                ) else {
   508	                    if self.activeFileTreeScanID == scanID {
   509	                        self.isFileTreeScanRunning = false
   510	                        self.fileTreeRescanRequested = false
   511	                    }
   512	                    return
   513	                }
   514	                self.applyScanResult(scanResult, workspace: workspace)
   515	                self.isFileTreeScanRunning = false
   516	                if self.fileTreeRescanRequested {
   517	                    self.runFileTreeScan(for: workspace)
   518	                }
   519	            }
   520	        }
   521	    }

   540	    @discardableResult
   541	    private static func cleanOrphanedMedia(
   542	        mediaFiles: [URL], workspace: URL
   543	    ) -> Set<URL> {
   544	        var removed: Set<URL> = []
   545	        for mediaURL in mediaFiles {
   546	            let filename = mediaURL.lastPathComponent
   547	            var isReferenced = false
   548	            let enumerator = FileManager.default.enumerator(
   549	                at: workspace,
   550	                includingPropertiesForKeys: [.isDirectoryKey],
   551	                options: [.skipsHiddenFiles]
   552	            )
   553	            while let fileURL = enumerator?.nextObject() as? URL {
   554	                guard fileURL.pathExtension == "md",
   555	                      let content = try? String(
   556	                          contentsOf: fileURL, encoding: .utf8
   557	                      ),
   558	                      content.contains(filename)
   559	                else { continue }
   560	                isReferenced = true
   561	                break
   562	            }
   563	            if !isReferenced {
   564	                try? FileManager.default.trashItem(
   565	                    at: mediaURL, resultingItemURL: nil
   566	                )
   567	                removed.insert(mediaURL)
   568	            }
   569	        }
   570	        return removed
   571	    }

   816	    func save() {
   817	        guard currentIndex >= 0 && currentIndex < openFiles.count else { return }
   818	        let doc = openFiles[currentIndex]
   819	        try? doc.save(doc.content)
   820	
   821	        // Rename Untitled files based on first line
   822	        if doc.url.lastPathComponent.hasPrefix("Untitled") {
   823	            if let newURL = renamedURL(for: doc) {
   824	                try? FileManager.default.moveItem(at: doc.url, to: newURL)

   826	                loadFileTree()

   828	        }
   829	        openFiles[currentIndex].isDirty = false
   830	
   831	        // Incremental index updates after save
   832	        let savedContent = openFiles[currentIndex].content.string
   833	        let savedURL = openFiles[currentIndex].url
   834	        noteIndex.updateFile(savedURL, content: savedContent)
   835	        backlinkIndex.updateFile(savedURL, content: savedContent)
   836	        tagIndex.updateFile(savedURL, content: savedContent)
   837	        peopleIndex.updateFile(savedURL, content: savedContent)

   840	    func saveAll() {
   841	        // Collect documents to save on main thread
   842	        var docsToSave: [(url: URL, content: String, isDocx: Bool, index: Int)] = []
   843	        var renameOps: [(index: Int, oldURL: URL, newURL: URL)] = []
   844	
   845	        for index in openFiles.indices where openFiles[index].isDirty {
   846	            let doc = openFiles[index]
   847	            let isDocx = doc.url.pathExtension.lowercased() == "docx"
   848	
   849	            // For docx, save synchronously (needs attributed string)
   850	            if isDocx {
   851	                try? doc.save(doc.content)
   852	            } else {
   853	                docsToSave.append((doc.url, doc.content.string, isDocx, index))
   854	            }
   855	
   856	            // Check for rename
   857	            if doc.url.lastPathComponent.hasPrefix("Untitled"),
   858	               let newURL = renamedURL(for: doc) {
   859	                renameOps.append((index, doc.url, newURL))
   860	            }
   861	
   862	            openFiles[index].isDirty = false
   863	
   864	            // Update indexes on main thread
   865	            let savedURL = openFiles[index].url
   866	            let savedContent = openFiles[index].content.string
   867	            noteIndex.updateFile(savedURL, content: savedContent)
   868	            backlinkIndex.updateFile(savedURL, content: savedContent)
   869	            tagIndex.updateFile(savedURL, content: savedContent)
   870	            peopleIndex.updateFile(savedURL, content: savedContent)
   871	        }
   872	
   873	        // Background save for plain text files
   874	        if !docsToSave.isEmpty {
   875	            saveQueue.cancelAllOperations()
   876	            let operation = BlockOperation { [docsToSave] in
   877	                for doc in docsToSave {
   878	                    try? doc.content.write(to: doc.url, atomically: true, encoding: .utf8)
   879	                }
   880	            }
   881	            saveQueue.addOperation(operation)
   882	        }
   883	
   884	        // Handle renames on main thread
   885	        for rename in renameOps {
   886	            try? FileManager.default.moveItem(at: rename.oldURL, to: rename.newURL)
   887	            let content = openFiles[rename.index].content
   888	            openFiles[rename.index] = Document(url: rename.newURL, content: content)
   889	        }
   890	        if !renameOps.isEmpty { loadFileTree() }
   891	
   892	        dailyNoteManager.saveAll()
   893	    }

   895	    private func renamedURL(for doc: Document) -> URL? {
   896	        let firstLine = doc.content.string.components(separatedBy: "\n").first ?? ""
   897	        let cleaned = firstLine
   898	            .trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespaces)
   899	            .replacingOccurrences(of: "#", with: "")
   900	            .trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespaces)
   901	            .prefix(50)
   902	        guard !cleaned.isEmpty else { return nil }
   903	        let safeName = String(cleaned).replacingOccurrences(of: "/", with: "-")
   904	        let ext = doc.url.pathExtension
   905	        let newURL = doc.url.deletingLastPathComponent()
   906	            .appendingPathComponent("\(safeName).\(ext)")
   907	        guard !FileManager.default.fileExists(atPath: newURL.path) else { return nil }
   908	        return newURL
   909	    }

   935	    func addFileToInMemoryTree(_ fileURL: URL) {
   936	        guard let workspace else { return }
   937	        let relativePath = fileURL.path.replacingOccurrences(
   938	            of: workspace.path + "/", with: ""
   939	        )
   940	        let components = relativePath.split(separator: "/").map(String.init)

   944	
   945	    private static func insertingNode(
   946	        _ target: URL,
   947	        path: [String],
   948	        into nodes: [FileTreeNode]
   949	    ) -> [FileTreeNode] {
   950	        guard let first = path.first else { return nodes }
   951	        let rest = Array(path.dropFirst())
   952	
   953	        for (index, node) in nodes.enumerated() where node.url.lastPathComponent == first {
   954	            if rest.isEmpty {
   955	                return nodes // Already exists
   956	            }
   957	            if node.isDirectory, let children = node.children {
   958	                var updated = nodes
   959	                updated[index] = FileTreeNode(
   960	                    url: node.url,
   961	                    isDirectory: true,
   962	                    children: insertingNode(target, path: rest, into: children)
   963	                )
   964	                return updated
   965	            }
   966	            return nodes
   967	        }
   968	
   969	        // Not found — add new node
   970	        if rest.isEmpty {
   971	            let newNode = FileTreeNode(url: target, isDirectory: false, children: nil)
   972	            return (nodes + [newNode]).sorted { $0.url.lastPathComponent < $1.url.lastPathComponent }
   973	        }
   974	        return nodes
   975	    }
   976	
   977	    private static func removingNode(_ target: URL, from nodes: [FileTreeNode]) -> [FileTreeNode] {
   978	        nodes.compactMap { node in
   979	            if equivalentFileURL(node.url, target) {
   980	                return nil
   981	            }
   982	
   983	            if node.isDirectory, let children = node.children {
   984	                let prunedChildren = removingNode(target, from: children)
   985	                return FileTreeNode(url: node.url, isDirectory: true, children: prunedChildren)
   986	            }
   987	
   988	            return node
   989	        }
   990	    }

  1166	    @discardableResult
  1167	    func delete(_ url: URL) -> Bool {
  1168	        let candidates = Self.deletionCandidates(for: url)
  1169	
  1170	        // Close if open (canonical path match prevents stale tabs)
  1171	        if let idx = openFiles.firstIndex(
  1172	            where: { openFile in
  1173	                candidates.contains { Self.equivalentFileURL(openFile.url, $0) }
  1174	            }
  1175	        ) {
  1176	            closeTab(at: idx)
  1177	        }
  1178	
  1179	        switch deleteFromDisk(url, scope: .workspace) {
  1180	        case .deleted(let deletedURL):
  1181	            resetFileTreeScanState()
  1182	            removeFileFromInMemoryTree(deletedURL)
  1183	            rebuildIndexesFromCurrentTree()
  1184	            scheduleFileTreeReload(delaySeconds: 0.6)

  1186	        case .notFound:
  1187	            resetFileTreeScanState()
  1188	            removeFileFromInMemoryTree(url)
  1189	            rebuildIndexesFromCurrentTree()
  1190	            scheduleFileTreeReload(delaySeconds: 0.6)
  1191	            return false
  1192	        case .failed(let message):
  1193	            print("[DocumentStore] Failed to delete \(url.path): \(message)")
  1194	            return false
  1195	        }
  1196	    }

  1337	    func deleteFromDisk(_ sourceURL: URL, scope: DiskDeleteScope) -> DiskDeleteResult {

  1339	            return .failed("Refusing to delete outside workspace scope")
  1340	        }
  1341	
  1342	        let candidates = Self.deletionCandidates(for: sourceURL)
  1343	        var didFindExistingCandidate = false
  1344	        var latestErrorMessage: String?
  1345	        var visitedPaths: Set<String> = []
  1346	
  1347	        for candidateURL in candidates {
  1348	            let normalizedPath = candidateURL.standardizedFileURL.path
  1349	            guard visitedPaths.insert(normalizedPath).inserted else { continue }
  1350	            guard FileManager.default.fileExists(atPath: candidateURL.path) else { continue }
  1351	            didFindExistingCandidate = true
  1352	
  1353	            if deleteFilesystemEntry(at: candidateURL) {
  1354	                return .deleted(candidateURL)
  1355	            }

   608	        var fragments: [String] = []
   609	        var phrases: [String] = []

   611	        var inQuote = false
   612	
   613	        for character in query {

   615	                if inQuote {
   616	                    let phrase = current.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines)
   617	                    if !phrase.isEmpty {
